name: A Brotherhood Betrayed
canonical:
It appears that a Bradon Lirrian

**Canonical Outcome:**
There is a rumor in Bruma about Raynil Dralas, who claims that he is a vampire hunter. You also learn that he has already killed an alleged vampire in town, a local man named Bradon Lirrian.

1. Learn from townspeople about rumors of a vampire killing.
2. Persuade a local investigator and widow to talk to you about the murder of the supposed vampire.
3. Ask around about the whereabouts of the vampire hunter, Raynil Dralas. Many point to Olav's Tap and Tack.
4. After attempting futilely to speak to Dralas, talk to Olav to be given a key to Dralas' room, where you find his diary.
5. Give the diary to Carius, who points you toward Boreal Stone Cave. Travel there quickly, as you only have one day to finish the quest.
6. Kill Raynil, and take his keys to recover the Mundane Amulet from the waterlogged chest.
7. Take the amulet back to Erline to reveal its true nature; you may keep the amulet as your reward.

name: A Brush with Death
canonical:
Help a distraught Tivela Lythandas

**Canonical Outcome:**
If you ask around town in Cheydinhal, people will tell you that Rythe Lythandas, a famous painter, has gone missing, and his wife, Tivela, is very upset. Go to the Lythandas house on the south side of town, and talk to Tivela for more information. Tivela tells you that Rythe had locked himself in his study, as he often did. However, after not seeing him for several days, Tivela decided to investigate. Upon doing so, she discovers that Rythe has disappeared.

1. Listen to rumors in Cheydinhal about the missing painter, and meet his wife, Tivela, in their house.
2. Tivela tells you about her husband locking himself in his room; go to his room, and enter the painting.
3. Find Rythe and he tells you about a thief who stole his magic paintbrush.
4. Find the thief's corpse and retrieve the paintbrush.
5. Return to Rythe with the brush and you will both return to Tamriel. He will reward you with the Apron of Adroitness.

name: A Dark Exile
canonical:
Defeat the Wrath_of_Sithis#Wrath_of_Sithis

**Canonical Outcome:**
Defeat the Wrath_of_Sithis#Wrath_of_Sithis

name: A Kiss Before Dying
canonical:
In Bravil

**Canonical Outcome:**
The dead drop for this quest is located just inside the Ayleid ruin of Nornal. Go around the first set of semi-circular steps, and off to the right is a half submerged gate. Pick the lock, jump the gate, or search the ruins for A Rusty Key; the dead drop is in an underwater area behind the gate. A copy of the key can also be found in the Leyawiin Mages Guild, on the second floor.

1. Find the next dead drop.
2. Learn of your new target, Ungolim.
3. Kill Ungolim.

name: A Knife in the Dark
canonical:
You must prove your worthiness to join the Dark Brotherhood

**Canonical Outcome:**
You may overhear a rumor spreading in Cyrodiil about the recruitment of the group of assassins known as the Dark Brotherhood: "They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members." This means that in order to become recruited by the Brotherhood, you must murder an innocent in cold blood. Once you have completed that, the cryptic message "Your killing has been observed by forces unknown..." will appear in the corner of your screen, indicating that the next time you sleep in any given location, you will be visited by a member of the Dark Brotherhood. For suggestions on potential targets to murder, see this page.

1. Once you've murdered an innocent, sleep in any bed in Cyrodiil (see bugs).
2. Receive a visit from Lucien Lachance.
3. Travel to the Inn of Ill Omen, south of the Imperial City.
4. *(Optional) Speak with Manheim Maulhand about Rufio.
5. Confront Rufio and kill him; then sleep again in any bed.
6. Receive another visit from Lucien and join the Dark Brotherhood.
7. Travel to Cheydinhal and enter the abandoned house.
8. Speak the passphrase and enter the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
9. Speak with Ocheeva and receive the armor of the Brotherhood.
10. Speak with Vicente Valtieri about your first contract.

name: A Mage's Staff
canonical:
Complete your induction into the Mages Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
After you have received all recommendations, travel to the Arcane University and speak to Raminus Polus. He will be in the Arch-Mage's Lobby during the daytime. At night, he will be unavailable to you. Once you are accepted into the guild by Raminus, speak to him about tasks to be told about the construction of your Mage's Staff. First you need to retrieve some special wood for the staff from Wellspring Cave, east of the Imperial City.

1. Speak with Raminus Polus about the Arcane University. Once accepted, your task is to have a personal Staff made.
2. Travel to Wellspring Cave only to discover there is a problem with the mages who guard this sacred place.
3. Make your way through the cave, taking care of (or avoiding) any enemies you encounter.
4. On the farside of Wellspring Cave dispose of the necromancers lying in wait.
5. Take the wood from the chest and return to Raminus, who instructs you to go see Delmar in the Chironasium.
6. Delmar asks you to choose the type of enchantment you would like and requests a full day's time to finish the work.
7. Return after a day has passed and Delmar will tell you to retrieve your custom staff from the cupboard in the back.
8. After you have your staff go see Raminus to be promoted to Journeyman.

name: A Matter of Honor
canonical:
Alval Uvani

**Canonical Outcome:**
This dead drop is in a coffin located just right of the entrance to Fort Redman, north of Leyawiin. Don't forget to acquire the schedule of Alval Uvani. The Dunmer merchant, a powerful user of Destruction magic, travels from city to city in Cyrodiil, stopping to sleep at inns and his rented house in the southeast corner of Leyawiin. The cities he visits are:

1. Receive the contract.
2. Find Alval Uvani and decide how you will deal with him.
3. Make your way to the next drop.

name: A Plot Revealed
canonical:
Travel to Bruma

**Canonical Outcome:**
Come back a few days after your last task from Traven and he will offer you another job that he doesn't have time to complete. You are to travel to Bruma and speak to Jeanne Frasoric there. He hasn't heard anything from her in a few days, and while he appreciates a break from her constant messages and questions, he is worried that this behavior isn't like her.

1. Speak to Traven a few days after completing Information at a Price. He wants you to check up on the Bruma Mages Guild.
2. Head to Bruma and go straight to the Mages Guild. The guild hall will be in flames once you enter.
3. Fight your way through the ruins until you find Camilla Lollia. Kill her.
4. Immediately after, J'skar will appear. Talk to him about what happened.
5. Return to the Arcane University to report to Traven.

name: A Rat Problem
canonical:
Azzan

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak to Azzan about Contracts then Rats to receive this quest. He claims that Arvena Thelas is having a problem with rats in her basement, but refuses to provide specifics. He says that you'll just have to go over to see for yourself. You can find Arvena in her house, which is just west of the north gate. [Remaster Image: File:OB-quest-A Rat Problem 02.jpg; File:OBR-quest-A Rat Problem 02.jpg; Could this be the problem?; right]

1. Speak with Azzan; he claims to have a job that's perfect for you.
2. Head over to Arvena's house and ask her about her rat problem.
3. Go down to the basement to discover and kill the culprit. Afterwards, head back to Arvena and speak with her again.
4. Find Pinarus Inventius and go hunting.
5. Return once again to Arvena to find your excursion wasn't very successful in solving her problem.
6. Follow Arvena's unknowing suspect around Anvil, watching for suspicious activity.
7. Once you catch the person responsible, make a decision that will determine what reward you receive.

name: A Ring of Keys
canonical:
A treasure hunt in Pale_Pass

**Canonical Outcome:**
While on the quest Lifting the Vale, you will go through the Serpent's Trail to Pale Pass and follow the path to the ruined fort. Once you reach the ruined fort, you're ready to find the treasure.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal. You must start Lifting the Vale quest before Pale Pass even shows up on your map.
2. Find four containers in order near the fort in Pale Pass.
3. A key found in each one allows you to open the next.
4. In the last container is the Circlet of Omnipotence which grants +3 Fortify each to Agility, Endurance, Speed, Strength, and Willpower.

name: A Shadow Over Hackdirt
canonical:
Seed-Neeus

**Canonical Outcome:**
To initiate this quest you must first meet Dar-Ma, a young Argonian woman who lives in Chorrol; the following events will not be set in motion until you've chatted with her. Luckily, meeting her is very easy: she is likely to run up to you in the street and introduce herself. You can also try looking for her at Northern Goods and Trade, the store run by her mother Seed-Neeus.

1. Talk to Dar-Ma in Chorrol.
2. Leave and return to Chorrol.
3. A few days later, visit her mother, Seed-Neeus, to learn that she has not returned from a trip to Hackdirt.
4. Explore Hackdirt to discover the town's hidden secret.
5. Rescue Dar-Ma and make sure she returns safely to Chorrol.

name: A Venerable Vintage
canonical:
Nerussa

**Canonical Outcome:**
Travel to the village of Weye, which lies just west of the main bridge into the Imperial City. Talk to Nerussa, proprietor of the Wawnet Inn in Weye. Nerussa is seeking some rare, fine wines and she will discuss what she's looking for if you talk to her about "Wine". She will request that you collect six bottles of Shadowbanish Wine, which can be found in some of the old fort ruins around Cyrodiil, and offers to pay handsomely for them.

1. Talk to Nerussa, innkeeper of Wawnet Inn in the village of Weye.
2. Find the requested six bottles of Shadowbanish Wine.
3. Return to Nerussa for your reward.

name: A Watery Grave
canonical:
You must kill the Gaston Tussaud

**Canonical Outcome:**
1. Speak with Vicente Valtieri for your first contract.
2. Go to the Waterfront District and sneak onto the Marie Elena.
3. Make your way up to the Captain's Cabin.
4. Once the Captain is dead, dispatch or flee from the ship's pirates.
5. Return to Vicente and receive your reward, the Black Band.

name: A Wound In Time
canonical:
Investigate a series of kidnappings on the Gold Coast

**Canonical Outcome:**
You can start this quest by asking about Rumors. You will be directed to Ilav Dralgoner, a priest of Akatosh on the road leading up to Kvatch. Alternatively, you can start this quest by speaking to Ilav directly and asking him about Hope.

1. Speak to Ilav Dralgoner about disappearances.
2. Go to Beldaburo, near the coast of the Abecean Sea.
3. Explore Beldaburo until you encounter a locked door protected by powerful magic.
4. Report back to Ilav Dralgoner.

name: Accidents Happen
canonical:
The mini-quest to get the contract from Vicente Valtieri is called "Blood of the Damned". To complete it, you just need to accept the contract from Vicente.

**Canonical Outcome:**
The mini-quest to get the contract from Vicente Valtieri is called "Blood of the Damned". To complete it, you just need to accept the contract from Vicente.

1. Receive your next contract from Vicente Valtieri.
2. Travel to Baenlin's house in Bruma.
3. Kill Baenlin.
4. *(Optional) Release the mounted Minotaur head.
5. Return to Vicente to collect your reward.

name: Acrobatics Training
canonical:
Tread the difficult path to find an Torbern

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once your Acrobatics skill is 70 or higher, speak with either Ganredhel in the city of Cheydinhal or with Tsrava in Leyawiin to learn who can teach you more about Acrobatics. You will be told that Aerin is the only one that can do it and you are sent to find her at her camp. They helpfully mark the location on your map.

1. When your Acrobatics skill reaches 70, speak with Ganredhel in Cheydinhal or Tsrava in Leyawiin.
2. Once you have the recommendation, head to Aerin's Camp to speak with Aerin.
3. When you arrive you will find Torbern instead, who agrees to train you.

name: Affairs of a Wizard
canonical:
The first Dead Drop contract at Hero Hill

**Canonical Outcome:**
This is your first contract as a Silencer of the Black Hand and is initiated by "The Dead Drop" mini-quest, which requires you to travel to Hero Hill to find your orders. Your target is Celedaen, a necromancer in Leafrot Cave who is trying to gain favor with the great Sovereign by attaining lichdom. Once you get inside, you will come upon a few leveled undead near a bedroll, with some alchemical equipment, a chest, and various books - make sure you look for the Destruction skill book, The Art of War Magic.

1. Retrieve your first dead drop from a hollow rock on Hero Hill.
2. Head to Leafrot Cave.
3. Learn of the lich's weakness, and decide how you will deal with Celedaen.
4. Head to the next dead drop under the Great Oak in Chorrol.

name: Ahdarji's Heirloom
canonical:
If you plan on doing all the intermediate steps to this quest, then before you embark on it, make sure to have at least one lockpick on you that you will be giving away. There will also be many locked doors, a locked chest and a locked jewelry box that you can deal with however you usually deal with locked items, including using spells and/or pickpocketing up to five keys, one for a dungeon, one for the secret room doors, one for the castle interior doors, one for the bedroom door and a final one for the jewelry box at the end.

**Canonical Outcome:**
If you plan on doing all the intermediate steps to this quest, then before you embark on it, make sure to have at least one lockpick on you that you will be giving away. There will also be many locked doors, a locked chest and a locked jewelry box that you can deal with however you usually deal with locked items, including using spells and/or pickpocketing up to five keys, one for a dungeon, one for the secret room doors, one for the castle interior doors, one for the bedroom door and a final one for the jewelry box at the end.

1. Go to your new Doyen, S'Krivva in Bravil, to receive this quest.
2. Travel to Leyawiin and speak with Ahdarji to get the details of the quest.
3. Discover the whereabouts of Amusei and question him about the ring.
4. Steal the ring from Countess Alessia Caro.
5. Return the ring to Ahdarji for a reward, and report to S'Krivva for another reward.

name: Alchemy Acquisitions
canonical:
Use the expertise of Julienne Fanis

**Canonical Outcome:**
You receive this quest immediately upon completing Confront the King. Simply follow your compass to find Julienne Fanis and talk to her about alchemical ingredients. She will reveal that you can place an ingredient in the Enchanted Chest in the Arch-Mage's quarters once a week and it will create several samples of it. She will also warn you that if you take longer than a week to retrieve the duplicated items, everything in the chest will disappear.

1. Raminus Polus informs you of a service provided to Traven by a guildmate.
2. Talk to Julienne Fanis about creating alchemy ingredients.
3. Use the Enchanted Chest to make more alchemy ingredients.

name: Alchemy Training
canonical:
Persuade a Sinderion

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you have an Alchemy skill of 70 head to the Bravil Mages Guild to speak with Ardaline or to Bruma to speak with Brotch Calus to learn who can instruct you more in Alchemy. You will be told that Sinderion, an Altmer alchemist in Skingrad, is the one you are looking for. He can be found in the basement of The West Weald Inn.

1. When you reach a 70 Alchemy skill, speak with Ardaline at the Bravil Mages Guild or Brotch Calus in Bruma to learn who can teach you more.
2. Speak with Sinderion in Skingrad to learn what he requires to train you further.
3. Retrieve two special bottles of wine and he will agree to train you.

name: Allies for Bruma
canonical:
You are asked to bring in Bruma Allies

**Canonical Outcome:**
Jauffre tells you that the Daedra are innumerable while the Bruma town guard are not. He therefore asks you to go and petition the other cities in Cyrodiil, the guilds and the Elder Council to send temporary relief troops to help close any Oblivion Gates that open around town.

1. This is an optional quest that can be done at any point after completing Bruma Gate and before starting Defense of Bruma. You can also partially complete it - i.e. get aid sent from some, but not all of the cities. Once you have completed the Defense of Bruma, Allies for Bruma will be automatically marked completed in your journal, even if you did not recruit everyone.
2. You are sent to request more troops for Captain Burd.
3. He tells you to petition the other cities, the guilds, and the Elder Council to send temporary relief troops to Bruma.
4. Go to each city and ask the count or countess of each for "Aid for Bruma".
5. After each city has provided aid, that city's troops will set up camp in Bruma.

name: Alteration Training
canonical:
Prove to an Tooth-in-the-Sea

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you have leveled up your Alteration skill to 70, head to Faregyl Inn, located northwest of the Inn of Ill Omen, or to the Chorrol Mages Guild and ask either the Khajiit publican Abhuki or the Bosmer spell merchant Athragar about further training in Alteration. They will tell you that the only one that can train you further is Tooth-in-the-Sea, an Argonian who enjoys swimming in the waters of Niben Bay.

1. Once you have an Alteration skill of 70, speak with Abhuki at Faregyl Inn or Athragar at the Chorrol Mages Guild to learn who can train you further.
2. When you have acquired the recommendation, speak with Tooth-in-the-Sea for master training in Alteration.
3. Prove yourself worthy of master training by surviving three hours underwater.

name: Ambush
canonical:
Oversee a contingent of Battlemages in their fight against the Necromancers and retrieve a unique Black_Soul_Gem

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak to Hannibal Traven to begin the quest, then travel to the ruins of Silorn directly southeast of Skingrad. Meet the three Battlemages (Iver, Merete, and the leader Thalfin) outside the ruins. They were supposed to storm the ruins but cannot—the door is magically sealed. Instead, they have decided to wait for the necromancers to come out and then attack. Ask the battlemages about their Abilities to figure out how best to arrange them.

1. Talk to Traven to receive your next assignment.
2. Travel to the ruins of Silorn to meet the battlemages.
3. Learn of the battlemages' strategy and prepare for the ambush.
4. When the necromancers leave the ruins, attack them.
5. Chase Falcar and kill him for his soul gem.
6. Return to Traven with the gem.

name: Amelion's Debt
canonical:
Help Biene_Amelion

**Canonical Outcome:**
Visit Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal after completing Drunk and Disorderly for Modryn Oreyn. Burz has a contract for you from Biene Amelion in Water's Edge, a settlement north of Leyawiin on the western shore of the Lower Niben.

1. Talk to Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal to receive this contract.
2. Visit Biene Amelion in Water's Edge to discuss her dilemma.
3. Decide on the path of your adventure and provide Biene with the means to satisfy her debt.
4. Return to Burz gro-Khash to receive your reward and further instructions.

name: An Unexpected Voyage
canonical:
The The Bloated Float Inn

**Canonical Outcome:**
Go to The Bloated Float Inn in the Waterfront district of the Imperial City. Speak to Ormil, the publican, and rent a room for 10 gold. Head below the deck to your new room. Now you must sleep, but before doing so, move the pitcher to find a bag with some gems (see Notes section below). When you wake up, your journal will update to tell you that the Bloated Float has been put out to sea. Leave your room and you will immediately run into a bandit named Lynch. Talk to him (the correct options are the bottom of the two responses each time) to obtain some important quest-related information:

1. Sleep on The Bloated Float; you will awaken to find it hijacked.
2. Speak with Lynch about the gang now commandeering the inn and free the bouncer, Graman gro-Marad.
3. Speak with and kill Minx.
4. Speak with and kill Wrath to obtain his key.
5. Make your way to the cabin to find the leader of the gang.
6. Decide whether to kill her or negotiate with her. Negotiate successfully and she'll surrender herself and her sword; Ormil will apprehend her.
7. Rest again in your room: the ship will be back at the dock when you wake up.
8. Speak with Ormil about the gang to receive your reward in gold.

name: Anvil Recommendation
canonical:
Investigate a number of deaths along the Gold_Road

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak to Carahil at the Anvil Mages Guild to request a recommendation. Her task is to investigate a number of deaths along the Gold Road and put an end to it. You are to speak to Arielle Jurard at the Brina Cross Inn for more information on the matter. Before leaving, be sure to talk to Carahil once more - this time about the topic Rogue Mage - which will prompt Carahil to tell you the deaths on the road were caused by frost magic, and consequently give you three free Frost Shell scrolls, which do help as the rogue mage heavily utilizes frost magic.

1. Speak with Carahil to be sent to the Brina Cross Inn.
2. Meet a Guild contact and get a room for the night, where you are later contacted in order to devise an entrapment.
3. Travel along the Gold Road until you are attacked by the Rogue Mage.
4. Return to Carahil and inform her of the events to receive her recommendation.

name: Armorer Training
canonical:
Prove your smithing skills to the Gin-Wulm

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once your Armorer skill is at 70, speak with either Rohssan in the Imperial City or Rasheda in Chorrol to learn that if you wish to improve your Armorer skill you will need to speak with Gin-Wulm.

1. Raise your Armorer skill to 70 and speak with Rohssan at A Fighting Chance in the Imperial City or Rasheda in Chorrol to gain the master training reference.
2. Learn what Gin-Wulm in the Imperial City requires to agree to train you.
3. Obtain the book The Armorer's Challenge and answer Gin-Wulm's question to receive training.

name: Arrow of Extrication
canonical:
Steal an arrow for The Gray Fox

**Canonical Outcome:**
After you have fenced 700 gold and have completed the previous quest, Turning a Blind Eye, go to the Imperial City and wait for orders from the Gray Fox. Amusei should arrive shortly, and will give you orders to go to the house of Malintus Ancrus in Chorrol. You meet the Gray Fox once more, and he will tell you that you need to steal the Arrow of Extrication from the Court Wizard of Bravil, Fathis Aren. Once in Bravil, pay a beggar who tells you about Fathis Aren. You find out that Fathis keeps his most treasured items in a ruined tower outside of town. There may also be a secret passage from the castle to this tower.

1. Wait for Amusei to find you, usually in the Imperial City.
2. Go to the house of Malintus Ancrus in Chorrol and meet with the Gray Fox.
3. Go to Bravil and talk to the beggars for information on Fathis Aren.
4. Find and traverse the hidden passage from Fathis' room to his tower.
5. Enter Fathis Aren's tower and steal the Arrow of Extrication.
6. Go back to Ancrus' house in Chorrol and give the arrowhead to The Gray Fox.

name: Athletics Training
canonical:
Prove to an Rusia Bradus

**Canonical Outcome:**
When your Athletics skill reaches 70, speak with Honditar in the city of Chorrol or with Hauls-Ropes-Faster in the city of Anvil to learn who can train you further in the Athletics skill. You will be directed to speak with Rusia Bradus, who also lives in Anvil.

1. Once you have an Athletics skill of 70, speak with Honditar in Chorrol or Hauls-Ropes-Faster in Anvil to get the master trainer reference.
2. Speak with Rusia Bradus in Anvil to find out her requirements before she agrees to train you.
3. Have at least 30 places discovered to receive Rusia's training.

name: Attack on Fort Sutch
canonical:
Help a group of soldiers close an Oblivion_Gate

**Canonical Outcome:**
Unlike most quests, this does not show up in your journal. The trigger for this quest is the delivery of the Mysterium Xarxes to Martin (part of the Dagon Shrine quest) and the subsequent opening of several Oblivion Gates across Cyrodiil. This particular gate opens at Fort Sutch, which is also the site of a Dark Brotherhood quest, Bad Medicine.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal.
2. At any time after completing Dagon Shrine, but before completing Light the Dragonfires, travel to Fort Sutch.
3. You will find a group of soldiers battling Daedra in front of an Oblivion Gate.
4. Help the soldiers defeat the Daedra.
5. Close the Oblivion Gate.

name: Azani Blackheart (quest)
canonical:
Help Modryn Oreyn

**Canonical Outcome:**
Modryn Oreyn wants you to meet him at his house after dark to discuss the Blackwood Company. However, you do not actually have to wait till night, as you can talk to Modryn about the Blackwood Company as long as he is in his house.

1. Meet with Modryn Oreyn and speak about the Blackwood Company.
2. Travel with Modryn to Arpenia and Atatar.
3. Defeat Azani Blackheart.
4. Return Blackheart's ring to Modryn.

name: Azura
canonical:
Kill some former worshippers of Azura

**Canonical Outcome:**
Azura's Shrine is located far north of Cheydinhal, north and slightly east of Lake Arrius Caverns, and high up in the Jerall Mountains. The shrine can be accessed using an unmarked road.

1. Once you have reached level 2, travel to the Shrine of Azura and speak to Mels Maryon.
2. Acquire one sample of Glow Dust to give as an offering to Azura.
3. Approach the Shrine of Azura and offer the Glow Dust at dusk (5-7pm) or dawn (5-7am).
4. Kill the former worshippers of Azura that are trapped inside of the Gutted Mine.
5. Return to the Shrine of Azura to receive your reward.

name: Bad Medicine
canonical:
Cure the sickly warlord Roderick

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak with Ocheeva to complete the "Enter the Eliminator" mini-quest and receive your next contract. She asks you to kill the ailing warlord Roderick at Fort Sutch and gives you a bottle of poisoned medicine. Only by sneaking into the fort and replacing his medicine bottle with the poisoned one, while remaining completely undetected, will you receive a bonus.

1. Receive the contract from Ocheeva and the new "medicine".
2. Travel to Fort Sutch and make your way to Roderick.
3. * (Optional) Remain undetected during the infiltration.
4. Switch the medicine with the poison in the cupboard.
5. Head back to the Cheydinhal Sanctuary to receive your reward.

name: Battlehorn Castle (quest)
canonical:
Rescue Battlehorn Castle

**Canonical Outcome:**
(left center), the Imperial City (behind Chorrol), and Skingrad (top right)]] After installing the download and loading the game, you will hear a rumor that Battlehorn Castle is under siege by marauders. This castle is located west of Chorrol. It can be reached by traveling west from the North Country Stables. Upon arriving at the castle you will find four marauders attacking it. Help out the outnumbered knights and kill the marauders. Of the four marauders besieging the castle, one is a male Nord marauder, one a female Imperial archer, one a male Altmer battlemage, and one a female Imperial Warlord.

1. After installing the download, a rumor appears about a battle at Battlehorn Castle.
2. Go to Battlehorn Castle and lift the siege on it by killing the marauders.
3. Visit Nilphas Omellian to purchase upgrades for Battlehorn Castle.
4. Go back to Battlehorn Castle and wait until a guard gives you a note about a Dwemer forge upgrade.
5. Finish purchasing upgrades from Nilphas Omellian.

name: Bear Season
canonical:
A Thorley_Aethelred

**Canonical Outcome:**
When you first find Shardrock farm, you will meet the owner, Thorley Aethelred. He will tell you that bears have been attacking his sheep, and the fence that he constructed has not worked. Thorley asks you to kill the trouble-making bears and bring back their West Weald Bear Fangs.

1. Talk to Thorley Aethelred about his bear problem.
2. Thorley tells you to kill the bears, collect their West Weald Bear Fangs, and return them to him.
3. Hunt down the bears and retrieve their fangs.
4. Return to Thorley with the fangs to be rewarded with a skill book.

name: Bittneld and Emfrid
canonical:
Help to bring two lonely hearts together (non-journal).

**Canonical Outcome:**
Author Casta Scribonia is well known for her romantic stories, but turns out to be equally romantic in life. When asked about Chorrol, she will tell you about two lonely existences in town, a guard captain and the proprietor of the local inn. She thinks they would be a perfect match, but will never reveal their names. The captain of the Chorrol guard, Bittneld the Curse-Bringer, seems to enjoy his work but isn't so keen on the town's female population. Ask him about Chorrol and he will tell you that although he thinks the women are "fine-looking", he also thinks they're snooty and not very nice.

1. Note: The quest is fully functional in Oblivion Remastered only. In the original game, most of this quest is skipped, instead going straight from Bittneld complaining about the town's women to Emfrid thanking you for bringing them together. The Unofficial Oblivion Patch re-adds the other lines.
2. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal
3. Talk to a local author who wants to play matchmaker.
4. Talk to Bittneld the Curse-Bringer about himself and his town.
5. Talk to Emfrid about Bittneld.
6. Return to Bittneld with a suggestion.

name: Black Bow Bandits
canonical:
Tag along with Mazoga the Orc (person)

**Canonical Outcome:**
After the Knights of the White Stallion quest, Mazoga spends most of her time in the White Stallion Lodge or nearby; however, three days a week she hunts for Black Bow Bandits, and she will invite you along. The Black Bows you collect can be taken to Count Marius Caro, who gives you 100 gold for each Black Bow you bring to him. When adventuring with Mazoga, note that she is not essential and may be killed at any time.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal
2. After you have completed Knights of the White Stallion, find Mazoga the Orc and she'll invite you along with her to hunt for more Black Bow Bandits.
3. On Morndas, you can join Mazoga and clear the Ayleid ruin Telepe.
4. On Middas, you will wipe out Rockmilk Cave.
5. On Turdas, Undertow Cavern needs a spring cleaning.

name: Blade Training
canonical:
Prove your reputation with a blade to the Alix Lencolia

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once your Blade skill has reached 70, head to either the Anvil Fighters Guild to speak with Rhano or to the Leyawiin Fighters Guild to speak with Sherina to get the master training recommendation. You do not need to be a Fighters Guild member to receive the recommendation. Once you have spoken with one of them you will learn that Alix Lencolia, famous in Cyrodiil because of his skills with a blade, is currently staying at Faregyl Inn.

1. Level up your Blade skill to 70 and speak with Rhano at the Anvil Fighters Guild or with Sherina at the Leyawiin Fighters Guild to learn who can train you further.
2. Speak with Alix Lencolia at Faregyl Inn once you have a known reputation.

name: Block Training
canonical:
Demonstrate to the Andragil

**Canonical Outcome:**
1. Once your Block skill reaches 70, speak with either Ambroise Canne in Skingrad or Lum gro-Baroth in the Chorrol Fighters Guild.
2. Speak with Andragil in Bravil about master training in Block.
3. Endure a beating from Andragil to prove your blocking skills to her.

name: Blood of the Daedra
canonical:
Locate a Daedra

**Canonical Outcome:**
After learning about the impending attack on Bruma by the Mythic Dawn, speak to Martin about his progress on deciphering the Mysterium Xarxes. It seems in order to open a portal to Paradise, four items are needed. So far he has only determined what one of those items is: a Daedric Artifact.

1. Speak with Martin about finding Mankar Camoran; he needs four particular items, the first being a Daedric Artifact.
2. Follow Martin's suggestions to learn more about Daedric Artifacts and their possible locations.
3. The quest names one artifact in particular to find and retrieve; any artifact from a Daedric shrine will do, however.
4. Give Martin the Artifact of your choice and give him more time to continue the translation of the Mysterium Xarxes.

name: Blood of the Divines
canonical:
Recover the blood of a Nine Divines

**Canonical Outcome:**
Martin tells you the next ingredient to open the portal is the Blood of the Divines. Speak to Jauffre to learn that the blood of Tiber Septim (who became the god Talos) can probably be found on his armor in Sancre Tor. These catacombs were sealed by the first Grandmaster of the Blades and any who have tried to explore have never returned. Jauffre gives you a key to Sancre Tor and wishes you luck.

1. Talk to Martin and learn of the "blood of the gods".
2. Explore the catacombs of Sancre Tor to find and defeat the first Undead Blade to learn about a curse.
3. Defeat the three remaining undead Blades to free them of the curse.
4. Kill the undead Warden to access the rest of the tomb, and watch the Blade Ghosts dispel the evil enchantment.
5. Obtain the Armor of Tiber Septim and bring it back to Martin.

name: Blunt Training
canonical:
A Irene Metrick

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once your Blunt skill has reached 70, go to the Fighters Guild in Anvil to speak with Azzan or to the Brina Cross Inn to speak with Christophe Marane. You will be directed to the Elven Gardens District in the Imperial City to speak with Irene Metrick, who is skilled enough to train you more.

1. Level up your Blunt skill to 70 and speak with Azzan in the Anvil Fighters Guild or Christophe Marane at the Brina Cross Inn to learn who is the Blunt master trainer.
2. Speak with Irene Metrick in the Imperial City and receive her challenge.
3. Once you kill at least 50 people, Irene will agree to train you.

name: Boethia
canonical:
Prove your worthiness to Boethia in the Tournament of Ten Bloods.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Travel to Boethia's Shrine, located southeast of Cheydinhal in the Valus Mountains.

1. Once you have reached level 20, talk to Haekwon at the Shrine of Boethia to find out about the gruesome offering Boethia requires.
2. Acquire and offer one Daedra Heart to Boethia and travel to the Planes of Oblivion to participate in an interplanar tournament.
3. Win the tournament, and return to the Shrine of Boethia for your reward.

name: Boots of Springheel Jak
canonical:
Find out where Jakben, Earl of Imbel

**Canonical Outcome:**
After you have fenced 800 gold worth of stolen goods, Thieves Guild messenger Amusei actively seeks you out, reporting that the Gray Fox will be waiting for you at Ganredhel's house in Cheydinhal. The Gray Fox tells the tale of a famous thief, Springheel Jak, who died 300 years ago and was put to rest still wearing his enchanted boots. He then asks you to locate Jak's final resting place and retrieve the boots. The only known descendant of the famous thief is The Earl of Imbel, who goes by the name of Jakben and lives somewhere in the Imperial City. The Gray Fox finally tasks you to locate the Earl and search his house for clues.

1. Fence at least 800 gold to receive the quest from Amusei.
2. Talk to the Gray Fox for further details.
3. Locate Jakben, Earl of Imbel.
4. Uncover the truth about Springheel Jak.
5. Defeat Jakben and retrieve the Boots of Springheel Jak.

name: Bravil Recommendation
canonical:
Recover Ardaline

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak with Kud-Ei in the Bravil Mages Guild about a recommendation for you. She wants you to go talk with Varon Vamori concerning the theft of Ardaline's Mage's Staff. In order to get the quest, make sure you talk to Kud-Ei about: Ardaline, Varon Vamori and Mage's Staff. She'll give you a Beguile scroll (providing a Charm effect) in case Varon is not cooperative.

1. Speak with Kud-Ei. She will ask for help recovering a guild member's stolen Mage's Staff.
2. Find the suspect and get him to admit to taking the staff and selling it.
3. Deliver the news about the staff being sold to Kud-Ei.
4. Travel to the Imperial City and find the buyer of the staff.
5. Purchase back the staff or persuade the buyer's wife to help you.
6. Return to Kud-Ei with the staff for her recommendation and a new spell, Captivate.

name: Breaking the Siege of Kvatch
canonical:
You must help defeat the Daedra

**Canonical Outcome:**
As noted in Find the Heir, Martin will not escape with you unless everyone else in the Chapel of Akatosh can leave safely, but the guard will not let anyone out until Savlian Matius gives the order. Savlian is too busy killing the Daedra outside the Oblivion Gate to aid in your quest, so your only choice is to offer to help him close it. Tell him you want to help, get ready for battle, and activate the gate.

1. Talk to Savlian Matius.
2. Enter Oblivion. Head for the Blood Feast (the Sigil Keep) and make your way up.
3. Take the walkway to the Reapers Sprawl to find the prisoner. Kill his keeper to get the Sigil Keep Key.
4. Walk back to the Blood Feast, get to the top, and activate the Sigil Stone. The gate will close and you'll find yourself back in Kvatch.
5. Help Savlian clear out the Daedra in the plaza in front of the chapel so the survivors inside can be rescued.
6. Talk to Martin and tell him to follow you to Weynon Priory.

name: Broken Vows
canonical:
Deep within the well of Skingrad

**Canonical Outcome:**
Your next contract can be obtained from inside the Skingrad Castle Courtyard well.

1. Retrieve the next contract from inside the Skingrad Castle Courtyard well.
2. Locate J'Ghasta in Bruma and eliminate him.
3. Move to the next contract at the Old Bridge landmark.

name: Bruma Gate
canonical:
Help the Bruma

**Canonical Outcome:**
Jauffre wants you to accompany the Bruma guard as they learn how to close an Oblivion Gate, as one has conveniently opened just outside. Find Captain Burd outside the gates of Bruma and repel the first wave of attackers. You are then to lead the charge into the gate in order to close it. Lead Captain Burd and his two men (whom he calls Bor and Soren) in after a short inspirational speech.

1. Martin informs you that Jauffre wishes to speak to you.
2. Learn from Jauffre that he wants you to help the Bruma guard learn how to close an Oblivion Gate.
3. Find Captain Burd outside the gates of Bruma and lead the charge into the gate.
4. Make your way to the top of the Sigil Keep and find the Sigil Key.
5. Enter the Sigillum Sanguis and disable the portal.
6. Speak to Captain Burd again who will inform you that he no longer requires your assistance.
7. Return with the news of your success to Jauffre.

name: Bruma Recommendation
canonical:
Find a J'skar

**Canonical Outcome:**
Talk to Jeanne Frasoric in the Bruma Mages Guild. She will request that you find J'skar - a missing mage who hasn't been seen in days. If you can find him, you'll have your recommendation from her. There are two possible ways to accomplish this quest.

1. Speak with the leader of the Bruma Mages Guild, Jeanne Frasoric. She needs help in finding a mage who has been missing for days.
2. Either look for J'skar by yourself or get help from Volanaro, his mischievous friend.
3. Tell Jeanne Frasoric that you have found J'skar to obtain her recommendation.

name: Burning Trail
canonical:
Follow a series of notes left by the Mythic Dawn

**Canonical Outcome:**
You can start this quest by asking about Rumors. You will be directed to the Imperial City's Talos Plaza District. Near the Dragon statue in the center, there is a note pinned to a barrel: Mythic Dawn Pamphlet 1. Reading it will direct you to Hircine's Shrine. You can also begin this quest by finding this first pamphlet on your own.

1. Find Mythic Dawn Pamphlet 1 on a barrel near the Dragon statue in Talos Plaza.
2. Find Mythic Dawn Pamphlet 2 near Hircine's Shrine.
3. Find Mythic Dawn Pamphlet 3 near Molag Bal's shrine.
4. Find Mythic Dawn Pamphlet 4 at the Lucky Old Lady statue in Bravil, on the right inside of the walled basin of the statue.
5. Go to the Lonely Suitor Lodge and speak with the innkeeper.
6. Talk to Ranaline. You may need to increase her Disposition.

name: Buy a house in the Imperial City
canonical:
Get your foot on the property ladder with a Shack for Sale

**Canonical Outcome:**
To buy a property in the Imperial City, you will need to speak to Vinicia Melissaeia. She works at the Office of Imperial Commerce in the Market District, where her main job is dealing with complaints about the local merchants. As long as her disposition is above 50, when you ask about properties in town she will at first be quite surprised by your interest, before explaining that the only thing available at the moment is a "hovel on the Waterfront".

1. Talk to Vinicia Melissaeia.
2. The house itself costs 2,000 septims, but you will need to furnish it completely (five upgrades) to complete the quest.

name: Buying a house in Bravil
canonical:
Purchase a Bravil House for Sale

**Canonical Outcome:**
To buy a property in Bravil, speak directly to Count Regulus Terentius at Castle Bravil. As long as his disposition is above 50, when you ask about properties in town he will disparagingly mention a "modest shack" which is available for sale. Pay the 4,000 gold and he hands you the keys. The house is on Bravil's southern island, next to The Archer's Paradox and below Luciana Galena's House.

1. Talk to Count Regulus Terentius.
2. The house itself costs 4,000 septims, but you will need to furnish it completely (six upgrades) to complete the quest.

name: Buying a house in Cheydinhal
canonical:
Purchase a Cheydinhal House for Sale

**Canonical Outcome:**
To buy a property in Cheydinhal, speak directly to Count Andel Indarys at Castle Cheydinhal. As long as his disposition is above 60, when you ask about properties in town he will mention "a typical Cheydinhal home" which is available for sale. Pay the 15,000 gold and he hands you the keys. As the Count informs you, the house is in the southwestern corner of the city. It is near the statue of Vanus Galerion and next to Willow Bank and Rythe Lythandas's House.

1. Talk to Count Andel Indarys.
2. The house itself costs 15,000 septims, but you will need to furnish it fully (ten upgrades) to complete the quest.

name: Buying a house in Leyawiin
canonical:
Purchase a Leyawiin House for Sale

**Canonical Outcome:**
To buy a property in Leyawiin, speak directly to Count Marius Caro at Castle Leyawiin. As long as his disposition is above 60, when you ask about properties in town he will mention a "quaint building" which is available for sale. Pay the 7,000 gold and he hands you the keys. As the Count mentions, the house is in the rather run-down central section of the city. It abuts the back of the Three Sisters' Inn and is across the road from Weebam-Na's House.

1. Talk to Count Marius Caro.
2. The house itself costs 7,000 septims, but you will need to furnish it fully (seven upgrades) to complete the quest.

name: Buying a house in Skingrad
canonical:
Purchase Rosethorn Hall

**Canonical Outcome:**
To buy Rosethorn Hall, a large manor in east Skingrad, you need to find Shum gro-Yarug, the Orc butler of Count Hassildor. There are two ways to do this:

1. Talk to Shum gro-Yarug.
2. You need to have a disposition with him of at least 70 and at least 15 fame points to convince him to sell you the manor.
3. The house itself costs 25,000 septims, but you will need to furnish it completely (fifteen upgrades) to complete the quest.

name: Canvas the Castle
canonical:
Chanel

**Canonical Outcome:**
If you talk to Countess Arriana Valga in Castle Chorrol she will claim to be in the middle of an investigation. If her disposition is 50 or better she will ask you to help, otherwise she will brush you off.

1. Speak with Countess Arriana Valga to learn of the investigation.
2. Speak to the witnesses and suspects to gather clues.
3. After the interviews, find any physical evidence.
4. Confront the culprit, and extract a confession.
5. Return to the Countess and either turn the culprit in or absolve them.

name: Cast out of the Thieves Guild
canonical:
Regain your honor among Thieves Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
When you join the Thieves Guild you are given three rules by which you must abide:

1. You have broken a rule of the Thieves Guild and are told to talk to Armand.
2. Talk to a Doyen and pay your fine to regain your membership.

name: Caught in the Hunt
canonical:
Ursanne Loche

**Canonical Outcome:**
A rumor floating around Bravil will tell you that Ursanne Loche's husband Aleron has disappeared. You will need to find Ursanne in order to pursue the matter further. Ursanne will tell you that her husband has racked up a significant debt by gambling. Now, an Orc loan shark named Kurdan gro-Dragol has taken him captive. Speak with Kurdan in The Lonely Suitor Lodge. As long as his disposition with you is 60 or higher, he will tell you that in order to release Ursanne's husband, you must travel to Fort Grief to retrieve an axe. If you agree to go, he will tell you that he has prepared a boat for you to use.

1. Learn of Ursanne's missing husband.
2. Confront her about this, and she will direct you to the loanshark, Kurdan.
3. Kurdan tells you to go to an island in Niben Bay.
4. When you arrive and speak to Aleron, he informs you it is all a game.
5. Defeat the pursuing hunters, and make it out of the dungeon.
6. Defeat Kurdan, take his key, and get off the island.
7. Return to Ursanne with the news, and receive your reward.

name: Cheydinhal Recommendation
canonical:
Recover a Ring of Burden

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak to Falcar in the Cheydinhal Mages Guild for a recommendation. He wants you to find a Ring of Burden an Associate recently lost. He suspects it was thrown down the guild well and says you'll need a key to get in; Deetsan—another guild member—has one. Deetsan will agree to talk to you about your assignment only if Falcar is not in the same room, which is the case between 1pm and 6pm. Once he's out of sight, you'll learn you're not the first one to get this task. Vidkun - the previous Associate - disappeared while trying to find the ring. After this word of caution, Deetsan will give you the Well Key and a Buoyancy spell.

1. Speak with Falcar, the head of the Cheydinhal Mages Guild, who asks you to find his lost ring.
2. Go see Deetsan to obtain a key to the outside well and a Buoyancy spell.
3. Retrieve the ring from the well and speak with Deetsan again.
4. Search Falcar's room for your recommendation, but find evidence of Necromancy instead.
5. Speak once again with Deetsan and she will agree to write your recommendation for you.

name: Clavicus Vile
canonical:
Retrieve the infamous sword Umbra (sword)

**Canonical Outcome:**
The shrine is located in the West Weald, a bit off the east of the Gold Road as it travels south, near Lake Rumare, and between Fort Virtue and the Ayleid ruin, Ceyatatar. You must find the shrine on your own; no one will tell you where it is.

1. Present Clavicus Vile with 500 gold once you reach level 20.
2. Clavicus will tell you that he wants the sword containing the soul of the warrior Umbra.
3. Retrieve the Umbra sword from the Bosmer, Umbra, located in the Ayleid ruin Vindasel.
4. Note: Umbra may be killed, and the sword retrieved, at any level, and even before initiating the quest. Once Umbra is dead and the sword is in your possession, speak with Ma'Raska to initiate the quest, then approach the shrine of Clavicus Vile.
5. Return to the shrine for your reward, the Masque of Clavicus Vile. Alternatively, you can refuse to give Umbra to Clavicus Vile, and you get to keep the sword as your reward.

name: Confront the King
canonical:
Find the Mannimarco

**Canonical Outcome:**
When you are ready, speak with Traven about tasks, he will say: "Are you truly prepared for this task? I cannot be certain what awaits you, but I am sure we will not speak again after you begin." If you change your mind about starting yet, he will urge you to hurry: "There is little time. Please prepare yourself as quickly as possible. The entire guild depends on you."

1. Traven promotes you to Arch-Mage and then soul traps himself into the Colossal Black Soul Gem.
2. Take the gem and travel to Echo Cave.
3. Make your way through the cave until you reach Mannimarco.
4. Talk with him for a while, then kill him.
5. Return to the University triumphant. The Arch-Mage's quarters are yours!

name: Conjuration Training
canonical:
A Olyn Seran

**Canonical Outcome:**
When you have leveled your Conjuration skill to 70, head to Chorrol to speak with Alberic Litte or to the Great Chapel of Talos in Bruma to speak with Arentus Falvius and learn who can teach you more about Conjuration. You will be told that Olyn Seran, a Dunmer worshipping Molag Bal at his Shrine can train you further.

1. Speak with either Alberic Litte in the Chorrol Mages Guild or Arentus Falvius in the Great Chapel of Talos in Bruma to learn who can train you more.
2. Go to Molag Bal's Shrine and speak with Olyn Seran to learn what he requires to accept to train you further.
3. Summon a Faded Wraith for Olyn to receive master training.

name: Corruption and Conscience
canonical:
The Ulrich Leland

**Canonical Outcome:**
The corruption started when the new captain of the guard, Ulrich Leland, arrived in Cheydinhal. Ask about "Rumors" in Cheydinhal and you'll learn the topic "Fines". Ask about the exorbitant fines and you'll be directed to the outspoken Llevana Nedaren to help fight the corruption. She tells you to seek out Garrus Darelliun in the Count's Castle. When you talk to him, ask him about Ulrich. You'll need a disposition of at least 60 with him before he'll tell you anything. Garrus tells you that he needs a witness to be able to bring the case before the Count. He directs you to Aldos Othran, a local drunk that lost his house after being unable to pay the various fines imposed on him by Ulrich.

1. Learn of the corruption in the guards, and speak to Llevana Nedaren to help fight it.
2. Nedaren points you to Garrus Darelliun, who will direct you to Aldos Othran when asked about Ulrich.
3. Speak with Othran, and he'll have an altercation with a guard in which he is killed.
4. Leave, and speak with Llevana who tells you to bring Ulrich to her.
5. Before you bring Ulrich to Llevana, speak with Garrus for an alternate method.
6. Decide which method to take.
7. When Ulrich is dealt with, you receive your gold and single fame/infamy point.

name: Daedric Quests
canonical:
Undertake mission operations to resolve Daedric Quests.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Undertake mission operations to resolve Daedric Quests.

name: Dagon Shrine
canonical:
Find and infiltrate the Mythic Dawn

**Canonical Outcome:**
You've finally been able to track down the location of Mythic Dawn's secret shrine to Mehrunes Dagon. The location, marked on your map, is in the northeastern part of the province at Lake Arrius Caverns, just north of Cheydinhal. Unlike Weynon Priory and Kvatch, you cannot immediately fast travel to Lake Arrius unless you happen to have been there before.

1. Travel to the secret Mythic Dawn shrine in Lake Arrius Caverns.
2. Steal the Mysterium Xarxes.
3. Return to Martin in the Great Hall of Cloud Ruler Temple.

name: Darkness Eternal
canonical:
Accept Vicente Valtieri

**Canonical Outcome:**
1. After the Dark Brotherhood quest The Assassinated Man, speak to Vicente Valtieri and select the topic "Dark Gift".
2. After Vicente agrees to visit you in your sleep, find a bed to sleep in.
3. Upon waking up you will get a message indicating that you were visited and that you have contracted Porphyric Hemophilia.
4. After three days sleep again and you will be a vampire.

name: Deepscorn Hollow (quest)
canonical:
Deepscorn Hollow

**Canonical Outcome:**
When you load your game you will receive a quest message telling you that you are the new owner of Deepscorn Hollow, at the far south end of Cyrodiil. Along with the message you get a bloodstained note.

1. After installing the download and loading the game, you receive a key and a note that says you inherited Deepscorn Hollow.
2. Travel to your new hideout southeast of Leyawiin. Once you arrive, read Greywyn's Journal.
3. You will be directed to Rowley Eardwulf at the Wawnet Inn to furnish your cave. Once you purchase all seven upgrades and the Ichor of Sithis (used to enable the shrine), the quest is completed. Note: The upgrades are only in his inventory during the night, when he sits inside the Inn on the stairs. When his shop is open outside while he sits on the crate, the upgrades will not be available for purchase.

name: Defense of Bruma
canonical:
Let a Great Oblivion Gates

**Canonical Outcome:**
[Remaster Image: File:OB-quest-Defense of Bruma 01.png; File:OBR-quest-Defense of Bruma .jpg; Martin talks to Countess Narina Carvain and Captain Burd; right] Just before you deliver the Great Welkynd Stone from the last quest, you'll see Martin (now hopefully wearing armor: if he is still in robes, see Bugs) and Jauffre debating about something. After they finish, talk to Martin, give him the stone and he'll fill you in on the last requirement: a Great Sigil Stone. The only way to get one is to allow the Mythic Dawn to open a Great Gate near Bruma.

1. Ask Martin about the Great Sigil Stone.
2. Escort Martin to the Chapel of Talos.
3. Speak with the Countess in Castle Bruma.
4. Make your way to the battlefield and eliminate all advancing Daedra.
5. Keep Martin alive until the Great Gate opens, then enter.

name: Deliver the Amulet
canonical:
You must deliver the Amulet of Kings

**Canonical Outcome:**
After exiting the sewers, your first task is to deliver the Amulet of Kings to Jauffre, the Grandmaster of the Blades. He resides at Weynon Priory, immediately south of Chorrol. Of course, you can postpone this task indefinitely and complete it at your leisure. However, Oblivion gates will not open until you complete Find the Heir (except the initial one at Kvatch, which will be active immediately after the beginning of the game), and you will get a free horse when you deliver the Amulet.

1. Travel to Weynon Priory, near Chorrol.
2. Go inside and speak to Jauffre.

name: Den of Thieves
canonical:
A gang of Bosmer thieves has been causing some problems around Anvil

**Canonical Outcome:**
You can receive this contract from Azzan in the Anvil Fighters Guild after you've done a few jobs for Modryn Oreyn in Chorrol. He'll ask you to look for a den of thieves that has been responsible for a recent spate of thefts in the area, referencing your past contract to help Norbert Lelles: "Good to see you're working hard. I've got some more thieves for you to deal with in Anvil. There have been a number of thefts in the area, and witnesses believe the thieves are holed up nearby. Check around, and see what you can learn." Azzan pairs you up for this mission with Maglir, whom you met recently on a past contract: "I'm not sure the numbers you'll be dealing with, so I'm sending you with another new recruit. Maglir. I believe you two have already met."

1. Receive the quest details from Azzan.
2. Discuss the contract with Maglir.
3. Speak with Newheim the Portly to receive additional details and an optional mini-quest.
4. Kill the thieves in Hrota Cave and (optionally) retrieve Newheim's Heirloom.
5. Return to Azzan and Newheim for your rewards.

name: Destruction Training
canonical:
A Bralsa Andaren

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you have leveled up your Destruction skill to 70, speak with either Delphine Jend, who is a member of the Mages Guild in Bravil, or with Marc Gulitte, also a member of the Mages Guild, in Anvil. They will tell you that if you wish to learn more about Destruction you need to find Bralsa Andaren, a Dunmer who is currently camping near a wayshrine of Kynareth in the Colovian Highlands, attempting to destroy the Divine's creations.

1. Once you have a Destruction skill of 70, speak with Delphine Jend in the Bravil Mages Guild or Marc Gulitte in the Anvil Mages Guild to receive the master training recommendation.
2. Bring twenty bear pelts to Bralsa Andaren so she agrees to train you further.

name: Drunk and Disorderly
canonical:
Find out why several of your guildmates are causing trouble in Leyawiin

**Canonical Outcome:**
After completing Unfinished Business, Modryn Oreyn gives you your next duty. Your fellow guildmates Dubok gro-Shagk, Rellian, and Vantus Prelius have apparently been getting rowdy at a tavern in Leyawiin, which is bringing the guild into disrepute. You're to head south to find out what's going on.

1. Receive the quest details from Modryn Oreyn and travel to Leyawiin.
2. Speak with the guildmates and the barkeep at Five Claws Lodge and learn of their frustrations.
3. Talk to Margarte regarding contracts.
4. Collect Ectoplasm to convince Margarte of the Fighters Guild's reliability.
5. Update the guild members on the latest developments.
6. Return to Modryn Oreyn for your reward.

name: Dunbarrow Cove (quest)
canonical:
Uncover a Cap'n Dugal

**Canonical Outcome:**
When you start or load the game, you will receive a message: :Centuries ago, a great battle took place in Anvil Bay. In the battle, the legendary pirate Torradan ap Dugal, the captain of the infamous Black Flag, was defeated by the first Count of Anvil. Rumors have been circulating of a hidden underground cavern beneath Castle Anvil. If the rumors are to be believed, then the final resting place of Captain Dugal and his ship have been uncovered. I should investigate these rumors as soon as possible.

1. Install the Thieves Den official download.
2. After receiving the message about the great battle of Anvil Bay, travel to Smuggler's Cave underneath Anvil Castle.
3. Find your way to Dunbarrow Cove and rid the Cove of the haunted Skeletons.
4. Visit Dahlia Rackham of the Clarabella in Anvil Bay to purchase upgrades, including a crew.
5. Once all upgrades are purchased the quest is complete.

name: E3 Demo quest
canonical:
Undertake mission operations to resolve E3 Demo quest.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Undertake mission operations to resolve E3 Demo quest.

name: Expelled from the Fighters Guild
canonical:
Regain your place among the elite Fighters Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
Regain your place among the elite Fighters Guild

name: Final Justice
canonical:
Beneath an Old_Bridge

**Canonical Outcome:**
Your next contract can be found within a rotten box beneath the Old Bridge, a landmark along the Red Ring Road south of the Imperial City.

1. Retrieve the next contract from beneath the Old Bridge.
2. Go to the Flooded Mine, and find your way to Shaleez.
3. Deal with her, then make your way to the next drop near the entrance to Fort Redman.

name: Find the Heir
canonical:
Head to Kvatch

**Canonical Outcome:**
Follow Jauffre's orders and travel to Kvatch. Once you arrive, however, you will find that the city is in ruins. There is a camp of refugees at the bottom of the hill and Hirtel will greet you in haste as he is running away, explaining that the city was overrun by daedra the night before, and that a few guards are fighting back the creatures pouring forth from an Oblivion Gate blocking the entrance to the city. If you ask him about Martin, he'll tell you he assumes he's dead "just like the rest of them". The other inhabitants of the camp will be more helpful, telling you they doubt he made it out the city, while pointing you in the direction of Captain Savlian Matius.

1. Travel to Kvatch.
2. From the Kvatch refugee camp, climb up the hill and speak with Savlian Matius.
3. Offer to help close the Oblivion Gate.
4. Complete the next quest.
5. Ask Martin to go with you to Weynon Priory.

name: Finding the Thieves Guild
canonical:
So you want to join the Thieves Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
There are three ways to find out about the existence of the Thieves Guild; the first is simply by accident, the second involves some detective work, and the third is by casual conversation.

1. Using whichever method you prefer, learn about the meeting at midnight.

name: Fingers of the Mountain
canonical:
Sort out a problem with a former Mages Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak to Teekeeus in the Chorrol Mages Guild about a recommendation, and you will receive instructions to find out what is bothering Earana - an excommunicated sorcerer. In short, Teekeeus just wants her out of town to avoid any trouble.

1. Speak with Teekeeus. He wants you to find out why Earana - an expelled mage - is hanging around town.
2. Find Earana around town and speak with her to be asked for help in retrieving a book.
3. Return to Teekeeus. He tells you to bring the book directly to him instead.
4. Travel north up the mountain to Cloud Top and retrieve the book.
5. At this point, you can either give the book to Teekeeus or Earana:
6. * If given to Teekeeus, Earana will ask you to steal it back (if you say no the quest will end here).
7. * If given to Earana, you will be asked to steal it back by Teekeeus (but wait until Earana gives you her notes first).
8. * Either way you will receive the Chorrol Recommendation.
9. Afterwards, take the note from Earana and head back to Cloud Top. Follow the instructions below to gain the Finger of the Mountain spell. (optional)

name: Following a Lead
canonical:
What have you been doing, puppet?

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you kill Ungolim, Lucien Lachance will run up to you in a rage and demand to know what you've been doing. He says you have betrayed the Brotherhood and must die for it -- but seeing the confusion in your eyes, he reluctantly concedes that you were not involved and tells you that your last few dead drops were not picked up. At some point the real traitor, the puppeteer of this murderous scheme, must have started replacing your dead drops with their own. He lets you know that you have been unknowingly and systematically killing all the other members of the Black Hand. J'Ghasta, Shaleez, Alval Uvani, and Havilstein Hoar-Blood were all Speakers and Silencers, and Ungolim was the Listener. He tells you that the surviving Black Hand members are hunting him because they believe he is the traitor. He tells you to go to Anvil and wait by the site of the next dead drop to find out who the traitor is.

1. As soon as you complete the previous dead drop mission, a furious Lucien Lachance appears and explains the very serious rift that's been unknowingly set in motion.
2. You are to travel to Anvil and uncover the root of the plot you have unwittingly assisted.
3. Wait near the next dead drop until the courier comes, reveal yourself and demand the answers you deserve.
4. Once you've been "slightly" more informed about the situation, head over to the lighthouse and speak with the lighthouse keeper to acquire the key to the cellar.
5. Make your way outside around back to the cellar.
6. Once inside you are treated to a non-living, breathing nightmare; search for clues and uncover the truth about this morbid plot.
7. Meet up with Lucien at Applewatch - you find him... "accompanied" by the remainder of the Black Hand.
8. Wait until a certain time and speak with Arquen to complete the quest and automatically start the final quest in the Dark Brotherhood quest series, Honor Thy Mother.

name: Frostcrag Spire (quest)
canonical:
In the Jerall Mountains

**Canonical Outcome:**
After installing the download and loading the game you will receive a deed telling that you have inherited a property called Frostcrag Spire from a long-lost relative. It is a wizard-style tower located east of Bruma. It will be marked on your map and available for fast travel; it can also be reached by following an unmarked road. Upon getting there you will discover an empty tower with extraordinary properties. If you start a new game with this download loaded, the deed and quest will be given to you right after you enter the sewers from the sanctum in the tutorial level.

1. After installing the download, you automatically receive the deed to Frostcrag Spire.
2. [OBR Change: you can learn of its location through a rumor instead]
3. Visit Frostcrag Spire to find out about the arch-mage who built it.
4. Travel to the Mystic Emporium in the Imperial City to purchase upgrades.

name: Go Fish
canonical:
Help Aelwin Merowald

**Canonical Outcome:**
Aelwin Merowald can be found walking around his house in Weye after about 7 or 8 in the morning. Talk to him and go through his dialogue in order to receive a quest to kill twelve Rumare Slaughterfish. When talking to him, it is advisable to not select the option to laugh at him, since laughing will decrease his disposition towards you by 60 points and end the conversation. If you lower his disposition below 20, he will not even start a conversation with you; a Charm spell will be necessary to get his disposition over 20 and receive the quest.

1. Find Aelwin pacing around his house and speak to him.
2. He will ask you to obtain a dozen Rumare Slaughterfish scales.
3. Dispose of the Slaughterfish and return to him for the Jewel of the Rumare.

name: Goblin Trouble
canonical:
Stop a Goblin Wars

**Canonical Outcome:**
At Crestbridge Camp you will find a small group of farmers (headed by Barthel Gernand) who were trying to set up a new village at Cropsford, a short distance to the northwest. However, goblins overran their settlement; they would like your help in putting an end to the goblin skirmishing. Their guide, Mirisa, can give you the details: Cropsford is between two caves occupied by rival goblin tribes, the Rock Biter Goblins at Timberscar Hollow and the Bloody Hand Goblins at Cracked Wood Cave. They are fighting because the Rock Biter Goblins stole the tribal Totem Staff from the Bloody Hand Goblins. You have two options for how to stop the fighting:

1. Speak with the refugees at Crestbridge Camp to learn about a goblin war that has overrun their village.
2. Get the goblins to stop fighting.
3. Let the refugees know that they can return and rebuild their village.

name: Great Gate
canonical:
Find the Great_Sigil_Stone

**Canonical Outcome:**
[Remaster Image: File:OB-creature-Siege Crawler.png; OBR-quest-Great Gate 02.jpg; The Siege Crawler advancing towards the Great Gate; right] As soon as you step through the Great Gate, you will be given 15 minutes (real time) to complete this quest. Any longer and the indestructible Daedric Siege Engine will make it to Tamriel, resulting in Martin's death and the invasion of all Tamriel by Daedra. At that point, the game is over: you must reload an earlier save game. This quest can also be terminated if Martin dies while you are in the Great Gate Oblivion World (although the combat in Tamriel actually pauses while you are in there, so Martin can only die if he receives a fatal blow just as you step into the Gate).

1. You have 15 minutes to complete this quest.
2. Enter the Great Gate and make your way to the World Breaker (the main tower).
3. Ascend the World Breaker tower to the Sigillum Sanguis.
4. Take the Great Sigil Stone to close the gate.
5. Return the stone to Martin.

name: Hand to Hand Training
canonical:
A Helvius Cecia

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you have achieved a Hand to Hand skill of 70, head to the Imperial Bridge Inn, located east of the Yellow Road, to speak with Davela Hlaren, or to Cheydinhal to speak with Ra'qanar, to learn that if you wish to learn more about Hand to Hand combat you need to find Helvius Cecia, a Thieves Guild member who resides in Bruma.

1. Speak with Davela Hlaren in the Imperial Bridge Inn or Ra'qanar in Castle Cheydinhal to receive the master trainer recommendation.
2. Reduce Helvius Cecia's health by half to prove you deserve his training.

name: Heavy Armor Training
canonical:
A Pranal

**Canonical Outcome:**
The only advanced trainer who can give you the master training reference necessary to start this quest is Varnado in the Imperial City. Valus Odiil, although not a trainer, will also provide the reference.

1. Once you have a Heavy Armor skill of 70, speak with Varnado in the Imperial City or Valus Odiil in Chorrol.
2. Retrieve the items for Pranal at the Roxey Inn and give them to Malene in order to receive training.

name: Helping Hands
canonical:
Hire a Eyja

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you have purchased Rosethorn Hall and the Servants Quarters Upgrade, it will become possible to hire a Nord woman named Eyja as a maid. She works at Colovian Traders and will likely approach you once you obtain the upgrade. If not, you can also look for her. Give her 150 gold (or less) and she'll move in.

1. Find Eyja in Colovian Traders; she will approach you if you've purchased the Servants Quarters upgrade for Rosethorn Hall.
2. Eyja will ask you about working for you; give her 150 gold, and she'll move in.
3. You now have a servant for your manor. Eyja can be found in her quarters or wandering around the house during the day.

name: Hermaeus Mora
canonical:
Capture one Souls

**Canonical Outcome:**
If the requirements have been met, you can proceed directly to the shrine and begin. If you have not yet met the requirements, you will be told by Ri'Jirr: "You have not yet followed the path required to speak with the Lord Hermaeus Mora". Unlike all other shrines, you will not be given any clues as to what is required, nor will a quest be added to your journal. Once the requirements have been met, Casta Flavus will appear the next time you sleep and inform you that you are now ready to start Hermaeus' quest.

1. Once you've met the requirements, speak with Casta Flavus, or activate the shrine directly.
2. Hermaeus Mora will instruct you to collect one soul of each race.
3. You will receive Hermaeus Mora's Soul Gem and the Mora's Soul Trap spell to complete this task.
4. Once all souls have been collected, return to the shrine and activate it.
5. You are rewarded with the Oghma Infinium which will permanently boost a series of stats that you must choose from a list.

name: Hircine
canonical:
You must make an offering of a Bear Pelt

**Canonical Outcome:**
Hircine's Shrine is located in the Great Forest, south of the Imperial City.

1. Once you have reached level 17, speak with Vajhira to find out that you will need a Wolf or Bear pelt as an offering to Hircine.
2. Hircine requests that you bring him a Unicorn Horn.
3. Kill the Unicorn in Harcane Grove and retrieve its horn.
4. Bring the horn back to Hircine to receive your reward: the Saviour's Hide Cuirass.

name: Honor Thy Mother
canonical:
Root out the Mathieu Bellamont

**Canonical Outcome:**
: Once you are through talking to Arquen at Applewatch, the remaining members of the Black Hand will travel to Bravil and seek the hidden sanctuary of the Night Mother to ask for her dark wisdom. The remaining members do not know the traitor is among them, so you must wait until the time is right to kill him. Once you are in front of the statue of the Lucky Old Lady, Arquen informs you the statue is a mask for the hidden entrance to the Night Mother's sanctuary. She will then recite an incantation to reveal the entrance, and all of the members will enter before you; go with them to meet the Night Mother.

1. Once you are taken to the statue, Arquen will speak with you and open the hidden entrance to the Crypt of the Night Mother.
2. Follow the members inside, where the Night Mother will speak with everyone and declare Lucien innocent, and the traitor present.
3. Once the traitor is unmasked, kill him.
4. The Night Mother will enchant your Blade of Woe per character level, name you as the new Listener of the Black Hand, and permit you to take any treasures from the Tomb.

name: Horse Armor (quest)
canonical:
Protect your Horses

**Canonical Outcome:**
After installing the download, you will receive a note informing you of the launch of a new barding service run by Snak gra-Bura of the Chestnut Handy Stables. To help promote the new service, the bearer of the note is entitled to one free set of horse armor. [Notice: In Oblivion Remastered; Oblivion Remastered, you will not automatically receive this note nor this quest, but you can still claim the free set of horse armor by speaking to Snak. A Rumors#Oblivion Remastered; rumor about the new services will direct you to her.]

1. Upon installing the download you receive a note informing you of a new boarding service run by Snak gra-Bura. A free set of horse armor is offered to anyone bearing the note.
2. Travel to Chestnut Handy Stables and speak to Snak gra-Bura.
3. Choose an armor style for your horse. You'll receive a free Old Nag with Steel armor if you don't own a horse.

name: Illegal Cargo
canonical:
Stop the illegal Sheep

**Canonical Outcome:**
At the Anvil harbor you will come across a ship on the far side of the harbor; The Sea Tub Clarabella. Entering its top deck you will encounter the violent captain of the ship, Captain Baszone Patneim. He will attack you on sight. After killing him, loot a note from his body (take the key too) and read it. The note is from his first mate, Filch.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal
2. Kill the pirates of the Sea Tub Clarabella and prevent the illegally shipped sheep from being delivered.
3. Claim Captain Baszone Patneim's treasure as your own.

name: Illusion Training
canonical:
Supply a Martina_Floria

**Canonical Outcome:**
Both Carahil and Kud-Ei will provide you the master training reference necessary to start this quest, even though the latter doesn't actually offer Advanced training.

1. Once you have an Illusion skill of 70, speak with Carahil of the Anvil Mages Guild or Kud-Ei of the Bravil Mages Guild.
2. Find and bring back 10 Welkynd Stones for Martina Floria at the Arcane University in order to receive training.

name: Imperial Corruption
canonical:
One of the Audens Avidius

**Canonical Outcome:**
Talk to Luronk gro-Glurzog or his friend Ruslan, who both usually hang around in the Temple District, and they will complain about being robbed by some Imperial watchman while shopping at Jensine's "Good as New" Merchandise. Go to the shop in the Market District and talk to Jensine. If you raise her disposition to 70 she'll tell you the name of the soldier responsible - Audens Avidius.

1. Hear complaints of a crooked Imperial Watch Captain.
2. Speak with the shop owner where this occurred and find out who's behind it.
3. Report this to numerous guards and be directed to Itius Hayn.
4. Find two witnesses and convince them to testify against the corrupt Watch Captain - Audens Avidius.
5. After ten days, provided you are over level 5, Audens will find and attack you.
6. Kill him and search his corpse for a note.

name: Imperial Dragon Armor
canonical:
Receive your Imperial_Dragon_Cuirass

**Canonical Outcome:**
After the cinematic of defeating Mehrunes Dagon finishes, Ocato rushes in and realizes what has transpired. Although he is concerned over what will become of the Empire, he is grateful that (almost) everyone survived and names you the Champion of Cyrodiil, a title only six other heroes have received in the history of the Empire. Ocato orders a suit of Imperial Dragon Armor for you, which is normally only worn by the Emperor, and says the armor will be ready in two weeks.

1. Talk to Ocato.
2. Wait two weeks.
3. Go to the Imperial Legion Armory in the Prison District.
4. Pick up your reward, a suit of Imperial Dragon Armor.

name: Independent Thievery
canonical:
Steal as much as you can, and sell it to a Thieves Guild fence.

**Canonical Outcome:**
This is an ongoing quest, triggered immediately after completing May the Best Thief Win, your initiation into the Thieves Guild. The sole purpose of the quest is to keep track of the amount of stolen goods you have fenced, as each and every 'special job', starting with Untaxing the Poor, requires a particular amount of fenced gold to become available. See quest section for requirements.

You will gain access to fences in a set order as you progress in rank within the Thieves Guild by completing the 'special jobs' offered to you by your Doyen. If you are not a member of the Thieves Guild, and select the barter option with a fence, they will claim that they do not know what you are talking about, and will not buy, or sell items. You can still invest in their shops though.

Fence !! Location !! Gold !! Mercantile !! Rank Required

name: Infiltration
canonical:
Deceive your way into the Blackwood Company

**Canonical Outcome:**
After Ajum-Kajin dies at Modryn Oreyn's house in Chorrol, Modryn tells you the next step is to infiltrate the Blackwood Company and its ranks so you can discover the secret of their strength.

1. Talk to Modryn Oreyn in his house in Chorrol to receive this quest.
2. Speak with Jeetum-Ze at the Blackwood Company Hall in Leyawiin to join their ranks.
3. Drink the Hist Sap and kill the "goblins" that have "invaded" Water's Edge.
4. Follow Modryn Oreyn's orders and speak with Marcel Amelion in Water's Edge to investigate the state of the town.
5. Return to Modryn Oreyn to complete the quest.

name: Information at a Price
canonical:
Travel to Skingrad

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you have been promoted to Warlock, speak to Traven for your next task. Count Hassildor of Skingrad has personally requested that you go see him to retrieve some vital information regarding the necromancers. Traven stresses that the good relationship between Hassildor and the guild must be maintained. Travel to the Castle Skingrad and arrange an appointment with the Count's new assistant, Hal-Liurz, in the County Hall. She says that he has been expecting you and will tell him of your arrival immediately, unless you have done the Vampire Cure quest and encountered the bug where Hal-Liurz gets stuck in the Chamber of the Lost, in which case you will have to go and find the Count on your own. If not, wait for her to return with the Count. If she doesn't return soon, and your compass indicates that she's traveling towards Kvatch, go to the map marker. The Count will be there, and you can continue with the quest.

1. Speak to Traven. He will tell you to go get some information from Count Hassildor of Skingrad.
2. Upon arriving at Castle Skingrad, speak to Hal-Liurz who will bring the Count to you after some time.
3. After speaking to Count Hassildor and learning of his problem, decide on a course of action:
4. *Kill the Vampires and get rid of the Hunters
5. *# Go to Bloodcrust Cavern and kill all the vampires. Grab some vampire dust from at least one corpse.
6. *# Talk to Eridor. Show him the dust, which will convince him and his hunters to leave.
7. *Help the Hunters kill the Vampires
8. *# Find Eridor and tell him the vampires are at Bloodcrust Cavern.
9. *# Wait for the hunters to go to Bloodcrust, and help them kill the vampires.
10. *# Once all the vampires are dead, talk to Eridor. If he is dead, your only option at this point is to kill all the remaining hunters (if any).
11. *Kill the Vampires and the Hunters
12. *# Go to Bloodcrust Cavern and kill all the vampires.
13. *# Use the compass to find and kill the Vampire Hunters.
14. *Have the Vampires kill the Hunters
15. *# Talk to Eridor and tell him that there are vampires in Bloodcrust Cavern.
16. *# Enter Bloodcrust Cavern after your journal says they have been killed.
