17. *# Kill any remaining vampires.
18. Talk to Hassildor to get his information.
19. Return to Traven to give him the information.

name: Information Gathering
canonical:
Bring Ajum-Kajin

**Canonical Outcome:**
Make your way to Chorrol and visit your old friend Modryn Oreyn. By now, the Blackwood Company is getting out of hand, and they must be brought down for the good of the Fighters Guild and the general public. Unfortunately, it's hard to tell where to start or what the source of their power is. Modryn tells you that a high-ranking member is currently holed up in the nearby Glademist Cave and that kidnapping him could yield valuable information. As this particular Argonian is very high up the chain of command and well guarded, however, he will make a difficult target.

1. Travel to Chorrol to visit Modryn Oreyn.
2. He will send you to Glademist Cave to capture Ajum-Kajin.
3. Work your way through the caves, defeating members of Blackwood as you go.
4. When you reach Ajum-Kajin, talk to him and he will agree to follow you back to Modryn.
5. Return to Modryn's house and speak with him. You must do whatever is necessary to make Ajum-Kajin talk.
6. Ajum-Kajin will answer the first two questions, but will kill himself rather than answer the third.
7. Talk to Modryn Oreyn again. He will give you an Amulet of Interrogation as your reward.

name: Join the Mages Guild
canonical:
Join the Mages Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
In order to join the Mages Guild, seek out a local head of the Mages Guild in any of Cyrodiil's seven guild halls. There is one in each city except for the Imperial City and Kvatch. All you need to do is ask to join the guild; as long as you have a clean criminal record you will be made part of the guild. You will be given a copy of the Mages Guild Charter and a Mages Guild Key that opens most of the doors in the seven guild halls. You are also now free to take almost all of the items you find in the guild halls and sell them for quick cash (there are still however a few privately owned items that cannot be freely taken, so pay attention to your icon before picking something up).

1. Talk to the head of any Mages Guild to join.
2. Complete all recommendation quests.
3. Gain access to the Arcane University.

name: Knights of the Nine Quests
canonical:
Undertake mission operations to resolve Knights of the Nine Quests.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Undertake mission operations to resolve Knights of the Nine Quests.

name: Knights of the White Stallion (quest)
canonical:
Join this Knights of the White Stallion (faction)

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak to Count Marius Caro after completing Mazoga the Orc's quest to begin this quest. The Count wants you to kill an Orc outlaw named Black Brugo, chieftain of the Black Bow Bandits. He'll suggest speaking with Mazoga, who may have contacts with outlaws due to her shadowy past.

1. Talk to Count Marius Caro about a dangerous bandit.
2. Speak with Mazoga for more information.
3. Travel with Mazoga to Telepe and kill all the bandits.
4. Report to Marius.
5. Return Black Bows to Marius for a bounty.

name: Legacy Lost
canonical:
Help long-lost twins recover their Weatherleah

**Canonical Outcome:**
After reuniting Guilbert and Reynald Jemane in Separated at Birth, talking to Guilbert reveals the quest to help them reclaim their childhood home of Weatherleah. They say that their family was run off one day by Ogres, hence the separation. Guilbert will give conflicting directions. The first subtitle directions he gives you are correct, "somewhere south of Chorrol, but south-west of Fort Carmala." The spoken dialogue for this line replaces south-west with north. Any subsequent time that you ask, both the subtitles and the spoken line will incorrectly say north.

1. After completing Separated at Birth, talk to Guilbert Jemane.
2. Discover Weatherleah and clear it of enemies.
3. Take the brothers to Weatherleah and receive your reward.

name: Leveled Item Quests
canonical:
Undertake mission operations to resolve Leveled Item Quests.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Undertake mission operations to resolve Leveled Item Quests.

name: Leyawiin Recommendation
canonical:
Help a Dagail

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak with Dagail in the Leyawiin Mages Guild about your recommendation. She wants you to find her amulet for her and directs you to Agata. Speak with Agata about a Seer's Stone, which helped Dagail with her visions. Agata says to speak with the other mages in the guild to see if any of them knows where it might be.

1. Speak with Dagail and agree to help locate her missing amulet.
2. Ask Agata about Dagail's troubles. She says you should inquire of the other mages.
3. After asking around and making note of Kalthar, return to Agata. She asks you to speak with Dagail once more.
4. Determine that you can find a replacement amulet in Fort Blueblood.
5. Fight through the fort and retrieve the amulet.
6. After the ensuing confrontation, return to Dagail with the amulet and receive your recommendation from Agata.

name: Liberation or Apprehension_
canonical:
Locate a Necromancy

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak to Arch-Mage Traven after completing the quest Necromancer's Moon. He speaks of how you've shown great promise and such, then gets down to the business of your next quest. It seems that in their efforts to gain information about the Necromancers, the Mages Guild has enlisted Mucianus Allias as a spy within the organization. This move has given the guild valuable information, but Traven now feels that the informant is in danger. In particular, Traven is worried that a group of Battlemages sent to find Mucianus by the Council of Mages will mistreat him or even mistake him for one of the necromancers. To prevent this Traven sends you to Nenyond Twyll—Mucianus' last known location—an Ayleid ruin to the south of the Imperial City.

1. Speak to Arch-Mage Traven who tells you to find Mucianus Allias and some Battlemages at Nenyond Twyll.
2. Once you arrive, talk to Fithragaer—the only Battlemage remaining.
3. Explore Nenyond Twyll until you find Mucianus Allias, who has been turned into a unique zombie called a Worm Thrall.
4. Return to Traven with the sad news concerning Mucianus.
5. Go visit Raminus for advancement to Warlock.

name: Lich of Lost Boy Cavern
canonical:
Follow the story of an exiled mage trying to save his friend from himself (non-journal).

**Canonical Outcome:**
You will first find a Weathered Journal outside the front door to the Lost Boy Cavern. This journal was written by a Mage, Vangaril, and describes his realization that his friend Erandur has become a Lich. The Mages Guild refuses to help Vangaril, so he resolves to enter Lost Boy Cavern alone and free Erandur's soul.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal. Also, it is best to only start this quest if you are level 23 or higher; otherwise, you will never be able to complete the quest.
2. Find and read the items that tell the story of Erandur and Vangaril.
3. Combat the lich.

name: Lifting the Vale
canonical:
Countess Narina Carvain

**Canonical Outcome:**
entrance, as penned by an Akaviri messenger]] Once your fame is at least 10, you may hear rumors in Bruma about the Countess and her collection of Akaviri artifacts. Talking to townspeople about the subject will direct you to the Countess's herald, Tolgan, for further information: :"Her steward, Tolgan, occasionally approaches individuals the Countess feels is worthy enough to seek her prize. If you're interested in assisting the Countess, you can always seek out Tolgan. He's usually in the Castle." Additionally, you can hear rumors in conversation in Bruma once your fame is at least 10: :"I overheard a guard mention the Countess is looking for a piece to add to her collection of Akaviri artifacts. Our taxpayer's drakes at work..."

1. Go to the castle once your Fame is at least 10, and the herald will request that you speak with Countess Narina Carvain.
2. The Countess informs you of an artifact that she wants you to recover.
3. Follow the map past all the markers until you reach the underground tunnel to Pale Pass.
4. Make your way through the fort. You will soon meet Akaviri Commander Mishaxhi.
5. Deal with him and recover the artifact from the same room.
6. Return to the Countess with the amulet to receive your reward.

name: Light Armor Training
canonical:
A J'bari

**Canonical Outcome:**
The two advanced trainers who can give you the master training reference necessary to start this quest are Ahdarji in Leyawiin and Luciana Galena in Bravil.

1. Once you have a Light Armor skill of 70, speak with Ahdarji in Leyawiin or Luciana Galena in Bravil.
2. Find and bring back an elven cuirass for J'bari in order to receive training.

name: Light the Dragonfires
canonical:
Escort Brother Martin

**Canonical Outcome:**
With the Amulet of Kings reclaimed and Martin Septim under safe watch, all that's left to be done is for Martin to relight the Dragonfires in the Temple of the One, resealing the barrier between Tamriel and Oblivion. However, there is still a matter of regal tradition: Martin wants the Elder Council's blessing to be accepted as Emperor without officially being an heir. For one final task, you must escort him to the Imperial Palace to complete the ceremony and end this ordeal at last. Upon arrival, High Chancellor Ocato greets Martin amiably and is about to officially accept him as Emperor when an exhausted and terrified messenger rushes in reporting Oblivion Gates opening inside the Imperial City's walls!

1. Escort Martin to the Imperial Palace.
2. Lead Martin, Ocato, and guardsmen outside to combat the Daedra.
3. Catch sight of Mehrunes Dagon, and wait for your journal to update.
4. Run to the Temple, then watch Martin turn into an avatar of Akatosh and battle Lord Dagon.
5. Ocato names you the Champion of Cyrodiil.

name: Lost Histories
canonical:
Finish a job from which a Theranis

**Canonical Outcome:**
After fencing items until you've received at least 400 gold from your illicit dealings, speak to S'Krivva in Bravil. She will tell you that another thief, Theranis, was sent to steal the book Lost Histories of Tamriel from a wizard in Castle Skingrad. You have to recover the book for the Gray Fox, with or without Theranis.

1. After fencing 400 gold in stolen items, talk to S'Krivva.
2. Travel to Skingrad to locate the missing thief Theranis and the book Lost Histories of Tamriel.
3. Follow Theranis' trail in Skingrad to Castle Skingrad's dungeon.
4. Discover Theranis' grisly fate.
5. Free a familiar face and retrieve the book.
6. Return to S'Krivva for your reward.

name: Mages Guild Suspension
canonical:
Collect alchemy samples to regain your Mages Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
Upon joining the guild you are presented with a copy of the Mages Guild Charter, which states that any crime committed against a guild member results in suspension. Unlike in the Thieves Guild, however, assault is not counted as a crime and only theft and murder will cause a suspension.

1. After breaking a rule of the Mages Guild, you are told to talk to Raminus Polus.
2. Collect alchemy samples and hand them over to regain your standing.

name: Main Quest
canonical:
Undertake mission operations to resolve Main Quest.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Undertake mission operations to resolve Main Quest.

name: Malacath
canonical:
Rescue some Ogre

**Canonical Outcome:**
Malacath's Shrine is located on the Gold Coast, west of Fort Sutch and north of Anvil.

1. Once you have reached level 10, find the Shrine of Malacath and speak to worshipper Shobob gro-Rugdush.
2. Donate a Troll Fat, and you will be tasked to free some Ogre slaves from a local mine.
3. Free the slaves, and return to the shrine to be rewarded with the warhammer Volendrung.

name: Marksman Training
canonical:
A Alawen

**Canonical Outcome:**
The two advanced trainers who can give you the master training reference necessary to start this quest are Pinarus Inventius in Anvil and Reman Broder in Skingrad.

1. Once you have a Marksman skill of 70, speak with Pinarus Inventius in Anvil or Reman Broder in Skingrad.
2. Find and bring back an elven bow for Alawen in order to train.

name: May the Best Thief Win
canonical:
You want to join, but are you a good enough thief?

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you have learned about the existence of the Thieves Guild, travel to the Garden of Dareloth and wait until midnight.

1. Meet with Armand Christophe at midnight.
2. Beat your competitors to Amantius Allectus' diary.
3. Return the stolen diary to Armand.

name: Mazoga the Orc (quest)
canonical:
Count Marius Caro

**Canonical Outcome:**
There's talk in town of an Orc named Mazoga who claims to be a knight. You can find her in the Leyawiin Castle County Hall, but she won't tell you much until after you've spoken with Count Marius Caro. Speak to the Count about "Service to Leyawiin" and he will ask you to find out what Mazoga wants. Speak to Mazoga, (who demands that you call her 'Sir', even though she is a woman) who wants you to find a local hunter named Weebam-Na, and bring him to her.

1. After hearing rumors of an Orc claiming to be a knight, speak with the count about her.
2. The Count will demand you to figure out what she wants. Speak to Mazoga; she wants you to find Weebam-Na, a local hunter.
3. Return to the count, and tell him what she said. He tells you about Weebam-Na.
4. Find Weebam-Na, and take him to Mazoga. She will want him to take her to Fisherman's Rock; Weebam-Na will respond, and promptly retreat.
5. Take Mazoga to Fisherman's Rock, and she'll confront Mogens Wind-Shifter. You should aid her in the battle to keep her from dying.
6. After the skirmish, she tells you of her becoming a knight and her experiences. You are free to loot the gang members' corpses.
7. Return to the Count, and he'll give you the opportunity to become a Knight-Errant of the White Stallion.

name: Mephala
canonical:
Start a feud between two prominent families.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Mephala's Shrine is located in the Great Forest, east of the Silver Road, halfway between where it meets the Orange and Red Ring Roads.

1. Once you have reached level 15, travel to the Shrine of Mephala, and make an offering of nightshade.
2. Activate the shrine with the offering between midnight and dawn to receive your task.
3. Kill the leaders of two prominent families in Bleaker's Way.
4. Plant evidence suggesting the deaths were the product of house warring.
5. Return to the shrine for your reward of the Ebony Blade.

name: Mercantile Training
canonical:
Prove to a Palonirya

**Canonical Outcome:**
The two advanced trainers who can give you the master training reference necessary to start this quest are Margarte in Leyawiin or Seed-Neeus at Northern Goods and Trade in Chorrol.

1. Once you have a Mercantile skill of 70, speak with Margarte in Leyawiin or Seed-Neeus at Northern Goods and Trade in Chorrol.
2. Collect 10,000 gold to receive training from Palonirya.

name: Meridia
canonical:
Wipe out a band of Necromancy

**Canonical Outcome:**
Chart a course west-northwest from Skingrad's west gate to find Meridia's Shrine between Cursed Mine and Shardrock farm. You must be at least level 10 to start this quest. Talk to Basil Ernarde at the shrine to begin.

1. Once you have reached level 10, find the Shrine of Meridia and make an offering of an ingredient from an undead creature to have Meridia speak to you.
2. After the offering is made, Meridia will instruct you to wipe out the necromancers in Howling Cave.
3. Once the necromancers are dealt with, return to the shrine to be rewarded with the Ring of Khajiiti.

name: Miscarcand (quest)
canonical:
Recover a Great_Welkynd_Stone

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you've found and brought the Armor of Tiber Septim to Martin, he'll let you know that the third ingredient he needs is a Great Welkynd Stone. This is a rare Ayleid artifact which - as far as he knows - can only be found in one place: the ruins of Miscarcand. He'll also warn you that the vengeful spirit of the last King of Miscarcand is rumored to guard it even in death. The ruins are marked on your map, halfway between Kvatch and Skingrad.

1. You are informed of the third item Martin needs - a Great Welkynd Stone.
2. Travel to Miscarcand.
3. Explore the ruins for the Great Welkynd Stone.
4. Fight the King of Miscarcand.
5. Return the stone to Martin.

name: Misdirection
canonical:
Help the Thieves Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
S'Krivva in Bravil informs you that Hieronymus Lex has invaded the Waterfront District, moving a huge number of the City Watch to patrol there in hopes of finding and arresting the Gray Fox. Armand Christophe has once again been placed under house arrest and many of your fellow Thieves Guild members have either been arrested or forced into hiding.

1. After fencing 300 gold in stolen items, talk with S'Krivva.
2. Travel to the Imperial City and locate Methredhel.
3. Steal Hrormir's Icestaff from the Arch-Mage's private quarters at the Arcane University and place a note.
4. Spy on Hieronymus Lex.
5. Return Hrormir's Icestaff to a retired mage.
6. Return to S'Krivva for your reward.

name: Molag Bal
canonical:
Goad the Melus Petilius

**Canonical Outcome:**
No one will add the shrine's marker to your map for you. However, it is possible instead to be referred to Olyn Seran, one of the worshippers at the shrine who is also the Master Trainer for Conjuration. If the Conjuration Training quest is active, a quest marker will be placed near the shrine. Alternatively, Burning Trail will have you visit this shrine as part of the quest.

1. Once you have reached level 17, offer a lion pelt to Molag Bal.
2. Near Brindle Home, goad Melus Petilius into attacking and killing you with Molag's Cursed Mace.
3. Be resurrected by Molag Bal and receive the Mace of Molag Bal.

name: More Unfinished Business
canonical:
Find out why a Maglir

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speaking to Modyrn immediately after completing the previous quest will start this one. He tells you that your old friend Maglir has defaulted on yet another contract, this time in Bravil, and he wants you to find out why once again.

1. Talk to Modryn Oreyn.
2. Find Maglir and question him about the defaulted contract.
3. Obtain ten samples of imp gall for Aryarie.
4. Return to Aryarie and Modryn for your rewards.

name: Mystery at Harlun's Watch
canonical:
Investigate the disappearance of some locals from Harlun's Watch

**Canonical Outcome:**
1. Speak to Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal to receive this contract.
2. Travel to Harlun's Watch and speak to Drarana Thelis for more information.
3. Check out the nearby swamps for the source of the mysterious "strange lights" near Swampy Cave.
4. Search the cave area for the missing locals and kill the trolls.
5. Return to Harlun's Watch with news about the missing locals.
6. Report back to Burz gro-Khash for your reward and further instructions.

name: Mysticism Training
canonical:
You must begin to repel the forces of Oblivion Gates

**Canonical Outcome:**
The two advanced trainers who can give you the master training reference necessary to start this quest are Boderi Farano in the Arcane University and Ita Rienus in the Bravil Mages Guild Hall. They will direct you to the wise Dagail at the Leyawiin Mages Guild.

1. Once you have a Mysticism skill of 70, speak with Boderi Farano in the Arcane University or Ita Rienus in the Bravil Mages Guild Hall.
2. Close three Oblivion gates to receive training from Dagail.

name: Namira
canonical:
Assist Namira

**Canonical Outcome:**
Namira's Shrine is east-southeast of Bruma and northeast of where the Silver Road and the Orange Road meet. Unlike several other Shrines, nobody can point out its location.

1. Once you have reached level 5, travel to the Shrine of Namira and talk to Hjolfrodi. You are deemed too attractive to worship Namira, so lower your personality to 20 or below.
2. Once you are unattractive, speak with Hjolfrodi again and activate the shrine.
3. You are next tasked with eliminating the priests of Arkay in the Anga ruin. You are given a special spell, Namira's Shroud to deal with them.
4. Travel to the Ayleid ruin Anga and cast Namira's Shroud on the priests.
5. Return to the shrine to be rewarded with the Ring of Namira.

name: Necromancer's Moon
canonical:
Find out about Black Soul Gem

**Canonical Outcome:**
After completing Vahtacen's Secret, Raminus Polus will tell you that he needs to find information on Black Soul Gems from Tar-Meena. Just head over to the Mystic Archives. When you first talk to Tar-Meena, she'll rage a bit about how she's got too much to do already, but once you mention Black Soul Gems specifically she agrees to help you out. Tar-Meena instructs you to find a book called Necromancer's Moon and mentions that Falcar has borrowed it. The book can be found on a small table in the lower part of the Library. Take it back to Tar-Meena and she'll tell you a little more information on it, as well as on an interesting event called Shade of the Revenant, before sending you back to Raminus.

1. Talk to Raminus Polus. He wants you to speak with Tar-Meena about Black Soul Gems.
2. Speak to Tar-Meena, who can be found at the Mystic Archives. She tells you to find a book called Necromancer's Moon.
3. Find the book in the lower room of the library on a small table. Take it back to Tar-Meena.
4. Bring the book back to Raminus. He'll tell you to talk to Bothiel.
5. Talk to Bothiel. She gives you a hastily scrawled note which you should take back to Raminus.
6. Raminus tells you to go to Dark Fissure Cave at the next Shade of the Revenant to observe the ritual of creating Black Soul Gems.
7. There are three ways to learn about the ritual:
8. * Waiting: Just stay outside the cave until the ritual occurs. It happens one night per week at midnight (a light will shine down on the altar). Just observe.
9. * Fighting: Explore the cave and find a Worm Anchorite. He will be the first person you encounter in the cave and will be immediately visible to you on the left path as soon as you enter the cave. Kill him, then search his body to find a Handwritten Note explaining the ritual (you can also pickpocket the note).
10. * Doing: Cast Soul Trap on the altar yourself when the time is right. This will trigger you "seeing necromancers perform the ritual".
11. Once you've discovered the ritual or retrieved the note, return to Raminus.

name: Next of Kin
canonical:
Next to the Great Oak in Chorrol

**Canonical Outcome:**
The entire Draconis Family is your new target. You start this mission only knowing the location of one of the Draconis family members: the mother, Perennia Draconis. She lives all alone on her farm called Applewatch not far west of Bruma. When you arrive at her house, she asks what you are doing there. You can either tell her that you are looking for her children, and she will mistake you for a gift deliveryman, giving you a complete list of her children's whereabouts and 100 gold to buy the gifts, or you can kill her and take the list off her corpse. Be cautious however: years of living alone have left her tougher than she looks and she has a pet dog to defend her, but you shouldn't have too much trouble.

1. Retrieve your next contract from a sack near the roots of the Great Oak tree in Chorrol.
2. Go to Perennia Draconis' home, Applewatch, to kill her and collect a list of her children and their whereabouts. (See the below walkthrough and notes for details on how to kill Perennia and her family without incurring a bounty.)
3. Locate and eliminate the four other family members.
4. Proceed to the Skingrad Castle Courtyard for the next Dead Drop.

name: No Stone Unturned
canonical:
Help an High Elf

**Canonical Outcome:**
To get the quest, travel to the Imperial Bridge Inn; it's just north of the first 'S' in the word 'Silverfish River' on your map. Inside the inn, you will meet an Altmer Sorcerer, Lithnilian, who proceeds to tell you about his research into natural growing Welkynd Stones in Bramblepoint Cave, and how he was disrupted by creatures and forced to flee, leaving his precious notes behind.

1. Lithnilian in the Imperial Bridge Inn will ask you to retrieve his notes from Bramblepoint Cave.
2. Fight your way through the cave and recover his notes in the third level.
3. Return to Lithnilian to be rewarded with 3-9 level-dependent potions.

name: Nocturnal
canonical:
Recover the Eye of Nocturnal

**Canonical Outcome:**
in Tidewater Cave, hidden among the rocks behind an underwater chest]] Nocturnal's Shrine is located off the Yellow Road north of Leyawiin, just past Blankenmarch. On the in game map, it is due west of the words County Leyawiin. Optionally, you can add a map marker to your map by talking to Alves Uvenim in Leyawiin Mages Guild (topic "Daedra shrines"; you must have already read Modern Heretics or have spoken with Ulene Hlervu about "Cheydinhal"). While you need to be at least level 10 to start this quest, an offering is not required. When you approach the shrine, you will be asked to recover the Eye of Nocturnal from a pair of thieves that are hiding out in Leyawiin. :Night among strangers. Secrets in the dark. Nocturnal is here. But my Eye is blind and drowned, stolen from its shrine, and hid in dark waters. To steal from a god is most unwise. In Leyawiin, two Argonians think themselves secret, but the Eye has seen them. Find these thieves in the city that spans the waters. Learn where they hide my Eye. Retrieve the Eye of Nocturnal, mortal, and return it to me, and I shall look favorably upon you.

1. Once you have reached level 10, approach the shrine, and you'll be asked to recover the Eye of Nocturnal from a pair of thieves.
2. Ask around Leyawiin to find out that the thieves are Argonians living in town.
3. Locate the thieves, and speak to them. You will receive a quest message instructing you to eavesdrop on their conversation.
4. Overhear their discussion to learn the Eye is in Tidewater Cave. Recover the artifact, and return it to the shrine.
5. Upon your return, you are rewarded with the Skeleton Key.

name: Nothing You Can Possess
canonical:
Umbacano

**Canonical Outcome:**
This quest is only obtained after selling Umbacano the third ancient Ayleid statue in the prior quest, The Collector.

1. After selling Umbacano three Ayleid statues, he'll give you a key and ask you to recover a carving from the High Fane.
2. Find out where the High Fane is (it's now called Malada).
3. Enter Malada and proceed till you find the door unlocked by Umbacano's key. The carving is just inside.
4. On the way out you'll be ambushed by another of Umbacano's treasure hunters.
5. Return the carving to Umbacano for your reward.

name: Order of the Virtuous Blood (quest)
canonical:
You are asked to help kill a Vampire

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once your Fame is 5 or greater, spend some time in the Temple District. A Dunmer woman, Ralsa Norvalo, will approach you to speak about a matter "of the utmost importance to the citizens of the Imperial City". She says her husband Gilen sent her to ask you to meet him at Seridur's house. Follow the quest marker to Seridur's house, located in the Temple District.

1. You are approached by Ralsa Norvalo who asks you to meet her husband at Seridur's house.
2. Meet Seridur, and learn about the Order of the Virtuous Blood.
3. Accept your assignment, and proceed to Roland Jenseric's house.
4. Travel to Roland's cabin and confront him with your intentions. Decide whether you'll kill him now, or listen to his story.
5. If you chose to listen to his story, proceed to Phintias, and interrogate him.
6. Learn of Memorial Cave, and fight your way through to Seridur.
7. Dispatch Seridur, talk to Roland, and return to the Order for your reward.

name: Origin of the Gray Prince
canonical:
Agronak gro-Malog

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak to Agronak gro-Malog in the Arena Bloodworks about "The Gray Prince" to begin the quest. He asks you to find proof of his noble birth, marks the location of Crowhaven on your map and gives you a mysterious key, but he is unsure what it opens. Journey to Crowhaven (northwest of Anvil) to begin your search. Bring cure disease potions or spells if possible as you may catch something from one of the denizens of this forlorn place.

1. Speak with Agronak gro-Malog about the Gray Prince.
2. Journey to and through Crowhaven until you find Lord Lovidicus.
3. Defeat or evade Lord Lovidicus, and find his journal.
4. Return to Agronak with the journal.

name: Paradise (quest)
canonical:
Enter Mankar Camoran

**Canonical Outcome:**
[Remaster Image: File:OB-quest-Paradise A.png; File:OBR-quest-Paradise.jpg; The Great Welkynd Stone (left) and Great Sigil Stone (right)][Remaster Image: File:OB-quest-Paradise B.png; File:OBR-quest-Paradise 02.jpg; The portal being summoned; right][Remaster Image: File:OB-quest-Paradise 02.jpg; File:OBR-quest-Paradise 03.jpg; The portal to Paradise; right] Go to Cloud Ruler Temple and find Martin ready to open the portal to Mankar Camoran's Paradise. He warns you that the portal will close behind you once you enter. Tell him that you are ready and he will open it. Go through as if it were an Oblivion Gate.

1. Enter the portal to Paradise.
2. Obtain the "Bands of the Chosen" by killing Kathutet or completing a quick task for him.
3. Complete another quick task for Eldamil to remove the Bands.
4. Follow the path to Carac Agaialor.
5. Kill Mankar Camoran and loot his body for the Amulet of Kings.
6. Teleport back to the Cloud Ruler Temple with the Amulet of Kings.

name: Paranoia
canonical:
Help a Glarthir

**Canonical Outcome:**
Enter Skingrad and you will meet a Wood Elf named Glarthir, who behaves in a disturbed way. He will stop you in the street and ask you to meet him behind the Great Chapel of Julianos, under the Stendarr stain glass window, at midnight. The Great Chapel is contained within the south walls of Skingrad. Once there, he will explain to you that he believes there is a conspiracy against him. If you don't meet with him immediately, he will keep showing up each night around midnight until you talk to him there.

1. Glarthir will approach you on the street and tell you to meet him behind the Great Chapel of Julianos at midnight.
2. Follow through with the meeting and he'll share his thoughts about a conspiracy against him. Glarthir identifies a conspirator and asks you to observe their movements for a day.
3. Optional: Follow the person that Glarthir has identified.
4. Return to Glarthir the next night with your findings. He will give you 150 gold whether you accuse the target or not.
5. Repeat the process for two other potential conspirators. This time, the rewards will be:
6. * If you report that they were not acting suspiciously, he'll give you 150 gold.
7. * If you report that the person was indeed spying on him, and had previously done the same for another target, he'll give you 200 gold.
8. After the third report, if you said that they were all innocent, Glarthir will not believe you. He'll attack you and you must kill him. If you said that at least one was guilty, Glarthir will instruct you to kill the accused. You can:
9. * Kill the intended targets and receive 1000 gold from Glarthir.
10. * Report Glarthir to the authorities and receive 1 Fame.
11. * If you accused Davide Surilie: inform him or his brother that Glarthir wants them dead and they will kill him themselves.

name: Permanent Retirement
canonical:
Adamus Phillida

**Canonical Outcome:**
The mini-quest to get your next contract from Ocheeva is named "The Assassin's Gambit". She tells you that you must kill Adamus Phillida, a recently retired Imperial Legion officer, who has taken up residence in the City Watch barracks in Leyawiin. For this task, you have been given an enchanted arrow called the Rose of Sithis. The Rose of Sithis is specially commissioned and crafted to kill one person--in this case, Adamus Phillida. When fired on anyone else, it only wounds them. If you can hit Phillida with the arrow when he is not wearing his armor, the strike will be fatal. Head to Leyawiin, stalk Adamus Phillida, and attack when the moment is right. The contract will be complete when Phillida is dead, whether you use the Rose of Sithis or not. When Adamus Phillida is dead, you can return to the Sanctuary for your reward. If you want to receive your bonus, however, there is one more task you must complete. Phillida wears an Imperial Legion ring. Take his finger, with the ring still attached, and put it in the desk of Phillida's Imperial Legion successor, in his office in the Imperial City.

1. Receive the contract and the arrow for the assassination.
2. Eliminate Adamus Phillida.
3. (Optional) Take his finger and place it in the desk.
4. Return to Ocheeva to collect your reward.

name: Peryite
canonical:
Peryite

**Canonical Outcome:**
Peryite's Shrine is located on the south bank of the Silverfish River, about where it begins to turn to the north (close to where the R at the start of 'River' is on the paper map). No one will give directions to it, so it must be found.

1. Upon locating the Shrine, you'll notice that Peryite's worshippers are frozen in a sleep-like state. You must be at least level 10 to begin this quest.
2. Speak with the Daedric Prince, who will inform you that their souls are trapped in Oblivion, where you must go and free them.
3. Tell Peryite when you are ready and he will send you to Oblivion, to locate and free the five trapped souls of his followers.
4. When all five souls have been freed, Peryite will open a portal back to Cyrodiil for you.
5. Return and speak with Peryite once more to receive Spell Breaker, an enchanted shield.

name: Raid on Greyland
canonical:
Help the Leyawiin

**Canonical Outcome:**
Just outside of the Leyawiin west gate you should meet a legion guard called Lerexus Callidus. Apparently, there is a drug trafficking problem, and he will ask you to help him put a stop to it. He tells you about Kylius Lonavo, a ringleader of Skooma dealers in the Greyland settlement. Lerexus firmly believes the only way to end the trafficking problem is to kill Kylius. You are asked to travel to Greyland, kill Kylius and any of his accomplices, and bring back Kylius' ring as proof of his death.

1. Meet Lerexus Callidus outside Leyawiin's west gate and speak to him about drug traffickers.
2. He will tell you that the Skooma dealer ringleader is Kylius Lonavo and ask you to kill him.
3. Travel to Greyland, and retrieve Kylius's ring by killing or pickpocketing him.
4. Bring the ring back to Lerexus to receive your reward.

name: Remastered Quests
canonical:
Undertake mission operations to resolve Remastered Quests.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Undertake mission operations to resolve Remastered Quests.

name: Repairing the Orrery
canonical:
Harness the power of the stars. Rebuild the defiled Orrery and unlock the secrets of this Mages Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
Upon loading the download you will automatically receive a note from Bothiel (a mage at the Arcane University), asking you to recover some missing Dwarven artifacts that are needed to repair the Imperial Orrery. The last known location of the bandits is Camp Ales, to the far west of Cyrodiil. If you start a new game with this download loaded, the note and quest will be given to you when you emerge from the sewers into the daylight at the end of the tutorial level.

1. Upon installing the download you receive a note alerting you that some part shipments for the Orrery have been hijacked by bandits.
2. # Note: In Remastered: talking to Bothiel in the Arcane University will start this quest.
3. Travel to Camp Ales to find the first bandit, retrieve a stolen part, and find out where the other parts are located.
4. Retrieve the other stolen parts from various campsites.
5. Return all the stolen parts to Bothiel and let her repair the Orrery.
6. Activate the Orrery to receive a greater power as reward.

name: Restoration Training
canonical:
A Oleta

**Canonical Outcome:**
The two advanced trainers who can give you the master training reference necessary to start this quest are Marz in the Great Chapel of Mara in Bravil and Ohtesse in the Great Chapel of Arkay in Cheydinhal. They will direct you to Oleta, a citizen of Kvatch.

1. Once you have a Restoration skill of 70, speak with Marz in the Great Chapel of Mara in Bravil or Ohtesse in the Great Chapel of Arkay in Cheydinhal.
2. Save the city of Kvatch to receive training from Oleta.

name: Revenge Served Cold
canonical:
Help a Corrick Northwode

**Canonical Outcome:**
In Harm's Folly, a remote one-house settlement northeast of the Imperial City, you will meet Corrick Northwode, a farmer who recently lost his wife Kayleen. If you talk to him about Avenge, he will tell you about how the local goblins killed Kayleen, and ask you to retrieve a Jade Amulet that the goblins snatched from her body.

1. Talk to a grieving farmer about his recently deceased wife.
2. Avenge the wife's death by killing a lot of goblins.
3. Return a keepsake to the grieving farmer.

name: Sanguine
canonical:
Crash a dinner party at Castle Leyawiin

**Canonical Outcome:**
The Shrine of Sanguine is roughly northwest of Skingrad and southeast of Fort Dirich at the edge of the treeline. Speaking to Fadus Calidius in Skingrad Fighters Guild or Falanu Hlaalu at All Things Alchemical will reveal the location of the shrine on your map (you must have already read Modern Heretics or have spoken with Ulene Hlervu about "Cheydinhal" for the topic to appear). You must be at least level 8 to start this quest. At the shrine, Engorm will tell you that you need to give Sanguine some Cyrodilic Brandy for him to grant an audience with you. Cyrodilic Brandy can be stolen from many nobles' houses; it can also be bought at the Main Ingredient or the Gilded Carafe in the Imperial City. Also, Bogrum Gro-Galash in the Lonely Suitor Lodge in Bravil has a chance of having it in stock. Three samples can be found inside the Odiil Farm just outside of Chorrol, one sample is found at Cloud Ruler Temple in Jauffre's room, and one can be found in Baenlin's House. With the preliminaries taken care of, approach Sanguine and offer the brandy. He will say: :Ah... another mortal come to beg Sanguine to add a bit of spice to an otherwise drab existence. I would have you perform a service for me. The Castle Leyawiin is a dull, dreary place. The mistress is an especially somber soul, and tomorrow she will hold another excruciating dinner party. I want you to liven it up. Use this spell on the Countess and her guests. I think it will make the party much more interesting. You should probably try to be inconspicuous. Or they might kill you. Oh, and the party is by invitation only. You'll have to find a way in. Have fun!

1. Once you have reached level 8, give Sanguine an offering of Cyrodilic Brandy to start the quest.
2. Go to Leyawiin and play a prank at the countess' dinner party using Sanguine's spell.
3. Flee from the guards in Leyawiin (while stark naked).
4. Return to Sanguine to recover your gear and receive your reward: the Sanguine Rose, a staff that summons random Daedra.

name: Saving Time Itself
canonical:
Recover a stolen Elder Scroll for the Order of the Hour

**Canonical Outcome:**
This quest picks up immediately from the previous quest, A Wound In Time. Upon informing Ilav about the magical barrier within Beldaburo, he will cast a blessing on you to allow you to pass through the barrier. He will task you with recovering the Order of the Hour's Elder Scroll before it can be used to open a Time Wound.

1. Receive the Order's blessing from Ilav Dralgoner.
2. Return to Beldaburo and enter the second zone, Beldaburo Anga.
3. Defeat Corelian and take the Elder Scroll from their corpse.
4. Speak with Ilav for your reward.

name: Scheduled for Execution
canonical:
The mini-quest to get the contract from Vicente Valtieri is named "No Rest for the Wicked". Vicente will tell you your next target is Valen Dreth. The name may sound familiar—he was the Dark Elf taunting you inside the Imperial Dungeon at the very beginning of the game. Revenge is a dish best served cold.

**Canonical Outcome:**
The mini-quest to get the contract from Vicente Valtieri is named "No Rest for the Wicked". Vicente will tell you your next target is Valen Dreth. The name may sound familiar—he was the Dark Elf taunting you inside the Imperial Dungeon at the very beginning of the game. Revenge is a dish best served cold.

1. Take the key from Valtieri, and make your way through the sewers.
2. Find Valen Dreth in his cell, and kill him.
3. (Optional) Do not kill any guards.
4. Exit the prison and return to Valtieri.

name: Secrets of the Ayleids
canonical:
Umbacano

**Canonical Outcome:**
This quest is obtained from Umbacano after returning the carving from the High Fane to him in the Nothing You Can Possess quest. Umbacano tells you that this is a bit different from what he's had you doing before, but still thinks you might succeed where others have failed. A rival collector of Ayleid artifacts has obtained the crown of the last king of the Ayleids, and Umbacano wishes to own it. The collector, Herminia Cinna, refuses to sell it to Umbacano, and he is hoping you can convince her to sell it to you. He gives you 1000 septims to purchase the crown, and tells you that you can keep whatever you do not spend; possibly encouraging you to steal it.

1. WARNING: It is recommended that you find and sell all ten Ayleid statues to Umbacano before Stage 60 of this quest. After this point, The Collector cannot be completed successfully.
2. After you return with the carving from the High Fane, Umbacano will give you the next assignment.
3. Receive 1000 gold towards "persuading" a rival collector to hand over the crown of the last king of the Ayleids.
4. Proceed to Herminia Cinna's home, and choose whether to steal her crown or retrieve another one.
5. Either way, return to Umbacano with your findings, and he will instruct you to act as his bodyguard at Nenalata.
6. Depending on your actions, you will kill Umbacano and his summoned creatures. After the brawl (or fleeing), make your way out of Nenalata.

name: Security Training
canonical:
Act as a courier for the J'baana

**Canonical Outcome:**
The two advanced trainers who can give you the master training reference necessary to start this quest are Dro'shanji in Bravil and Mandil in the Elven Gardens District.

1. Once you have a Security skill of 70, speak with Dro'shanji in Bravil or Mandil in the Elven Gardens District.
2. Get a message from S'Krivva for J'baana in the Imperial City to receive master training.

name: Seeking Your Roots
canonical:
After discovering a peculiar plant called Nirnroot

**Canonical Outcome:**
Nirnroot is a very noticeable, vibrant, greenish-blue plant with four large leaves, usually located close to water and emitting a quiet ringing noise. There are hundreds of locations where the plant can be found, but unlike every other plant in the game it does not regrow; each plant can only be harvested once. As a result, it is considered to be a rare plant. Details on where the plant can be found are provided on the Nirnroot page.

1. Harvest Nirnroot for the first time to be given a new quest. You should ask an alchemist about it.
2. Question alchemists to get no useful information other than to see Sinderion in Skingrad.
3. Find Sinderion in his cellar at the West Weald Inn in Skingrad. Ask him about Nirnroot, and he'll tell you a story.
4. He tells you to collect a certain number of Nirnroot which you should return to him. He'll tell you to wait 24 hours that so he may finish his research. When he's done, he rewards you with a potion, and you should repeat the process three more times.
5. When you've gone through this a total of four times, he'll have exhausted his research, and from now on he'll just pay in gold for any Nirnroot that you should return to him.

name: Separated at Birth
canonical:
Investigate rumors around Chorrol

**Canonical Outcome:**
If you walk around Chorrol and ask the locals about 'latest rumors', pretty quickly you'll hear about how some of them have seen familiar Chorrol resident Reynald Jemane walking around in Cheydinhal. Strangely, when the locals spoke to Reynald, he acted quite odd. Sounds like all this might be worth investigating. Go speak to Reynald. Apparently, he is also aware of these rumors. He gives you 50 gold and sends you on a mission to Cheydinhal to deal with the impostor.

1. Ask around Chorrol about rumors.
2. Talk to Reynald Jemane.
3. Travel to Cheydinhal to find Reynald's impersonator.
4. Speak to Guilbert Jemane to initiate the reunion.
5. Talk to Guilbert in Chorrol.

name: Sheogorath
canonical:
Fulfill an apocalyptic prophecy to satisfy Shivering:Sheogorath

**Canonical Outcome:**
Sheogorath's Shrine is located on the border to Elsweyr, halfway between Bravil and Leyawiin. You must find the shrine on your own; no one will tell you where it is. You must be at least level 2 to start this quest. Once you reach his shrine, talk to Ferul Ravel. You will be told to supply a head of lettuce, a Lesser Soul Gem, and yarn. All are quite common; lettuce and yarn are commonly found in random house clutter, and both are guaranteed to be in a number of homes in Border Watch. The Lesser Soul Gem might be slightly more tricky to find; several locations in Bravil, such as the local Mages Guild and the nearby magic shop A Warlock's Luck may have them. If the Shivering Isles expansion is installed, many shrines to Sheogorath in the city of New Sheoth will have these offerings.

1. Once you have reached level 2, travel to the Shrine of Sheogorath and speak with Ferul Ravel.
2. Acquire one sample of Lettuce, a Lesser Soul Gem, and a spool of Yarn and offer them to the shrine.
3. Travel to Border Watch and set up the plague of Disease and the plague of Famine.
4. Return to Sheogorath after he completes this "apocalypse", and receive Wabbajack as your reward.

name: Side Quests
canonical:
Undertake mission operations to resolve Side Quests.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Undertake mission operations to resolve Side Quests.

name: Sins of the Father
canonical:
A Fathis Ules

**Canonical Outcome:**
Approximately two days after helping the Jemane brothers in Legacy Lost you will be contacted by a Dunmer thief named Fathis Ules. You need to be in Chorrol for the quest to be initiated.

1. Talk to Fathis Ules at the Oak and Crosier Inn in Chorrol.
2. Go to the Redguard Valley Cave.
3. Defeat the ogres and take the Honorblade of Chorrol.
4. Return the blade to Laythe Wavrick or sell it to Fathis Ules.

name: Skingrad Recommendation
canonical:
Find a Erthor

**Canonical Outcome:**
When you arrive in Skingrad, you may overhear citizens and guild members talking about a strange, but relieving disappearance: "I hear one of the guild mages has gone missing again.", "Have you seen Erthor around town lately?", "It seems quieter than usual at the Mages Guild.", "Is it me, or is it quieter around here with Erthor missing?" and "Any sign of Erthor lately?"

1. Speak with Adrienne Berene. She asks you to obtain some notes from a mage that she forced to practice outside of the guild.
2. The other mages will fill you in on the details of where Erthor stays and why he stays there.
3. Head to Bleak Flats Cave and seek out Erthor.
4. Once Erthor is located, kill all the zombies and return to Adrienne with him for your recommendation.

name: Sneak Training
canonical:
Steal an item from the Marana Rian

**Canonical Outcome:**
The two advanced trainers who can give you the master training reference necessary to start this quest are Mirabelle Monet in The Fo'c's'le and Othrelos living in the Elven Gardens District of the Imperial City. They will direct you to the master, Marana Rian.

1. Once you have a Sneak skill of 70, speak with Mirabelle Monet at The Fo'c's'le in Anvil or Othrelos in the Elven Gardens District.
2. Speak to Marana Rian in the Imperial City to receive the task you must complete before she agrees to train you.
3. Steal her special coin to prove yourself worthy of training.

name: Speechcraft Training
canonical:
Cyrodiil's Tandilwe

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you raise your Speechcraft skill to 70, speak to Gruiand Garrana in The Great Chapel of Arkay or Varon Vamori in Bravil. They will inform you that they can no longer train you and recommend that you receive your training from a master, Tandilwe.

1. Once you have a Speechcraft skill of 70, speak with Gruiand Garrana at The Great Chapel of Arkay in Cheydinhal or Varon Vamori in Bravil.
2. Speak with Tandilwe in the Temple District of the Imperial City to know what she requires of you before training.
3. Speak to every beggar in Cyrodiil to receive master training.

name: Spies
canonical:
Track down those that have been spying on Cloud Ruler Temple

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you've given the Mysterium Xarxes to Martin, he tells you to speak to Jauffre about 'spies'. Apparently the gate guards have seen strangers along the road near the temple for the past few nights and Jauffre wants you to find them. Speak to Captain Steffan for more details. Steffan says the spies have been seen near the rune stone at the bottom of the hill near dusk.

1. Ask around about possible "spies."
2. Kill the two spies (Jearl and Saveri Faram).
3. Search Jearl's basement and recover the enemy plans.
4. Return to Cloud Ruler Temple with the information.

name: Taking Care of Lex
canonical:
Get Hieronymus Lex

**Canonical Outcome:**
Talk to S'Krivva in Bravil. She tells you that Hieronymus Lex is causing problems and that the Gray Fox would like him reassigned so that he can protect Countess Umbranox of Anvil instead of persecuting the Thieves Guild. She also explains that for some unknown reason the Gray Fox recently put the Countess under his personal protection. Anvil is in need of a new Captain of the Guard; your job is to replace the list of recommended candidates in Steward Dairihill's desk in Castle Anvil with a forged one that recommends Lex.

1. After fencing at least 500 gold in stolen items, meet with S'Krivva.
2. Travel to Anvil and steal the recommendation letter.
3. Have a new recommendation letter forged.
4. Sneak into the Imperial Legion Offices to seal the letter with the official seal.
5. Deliver the letter to Countess Millona Umbranox.
6. Take the "Transfer Orders" to Hieronymus Lex.
7. Return to S'Krivva for your reward.

name: Tears of the Savior
canonical:
S'drassa

**Canonical Outcome:**
A Khajiit named S'drassa at the Leyawiin Mages Guild wants you to bring him rare magical crystals known as Garridan's Tears. He usually jumps at the topic if you agree to hear his story in a little more detail when you speak to him for the first time.

1. Speak to S'drassa at the Leyawiin Mages Guild about Garridan's Tears.
2. Go to the Imperial City and talk to Julienne Fanis at the Arcane University.
3. Find the First Edition bookshop in the Imperial City Market District and purchase Knightfall.
4. Learn more on Garridan's Tears by reading Knightfall.
5. Revisit Julienne Fanis and buy some Refined Frost Salts.
6. (Optional) Go back to S'drassa and receive some Philters of Frostward to protect you from severe frost within Frostfire Glade.
7. Travel to the Frostfire Glade cave.
8. Use the Refined Frost Salts to open the sealed door at the back of the Frostfire Glade cave.
9. Search the central area of Frostfire Glade for Garridan's Tears.
10. Return to S'drassa to collect your reward.

name: The Assassinated Man
canonical:
Speak with Vicente Valtieri in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary to complete the "To Serve Sithis" mini-quest and receive Vicente's final contract. It seems Francois Motierre in Chorrol borrowed a lot of money from underworld types and has missed a payment. The lenders don't even want the money. They feel insulted and want him dead, sending an enforcer to kill him. Francois has hired The Dark Brotherhood to fake his death and take the life of his mother instead, a detail Vicente tells you has already been handled by Lucien Lachance. Vicente gives you the tools you'll need to fake Motierre's death: a single-use dagger coated with a special poison called Languorwine that can make it appear that a person has died, and an antidote to revive him later.

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak with Vicente Valtieri in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary to complete the "To Serve Sithis" mini-quest and receive Vicente's final contract. It seems Francois Motierre in Chorrol borrowed a lot of money from underworld types and has missed a payment. The lenders don't even want the money. They feel insulted and want him dead, sending an enforcer to kill him. Francois has hired The Dark Brotherhood to fake his death and take the life of his mother instead, a detail Vicente tells you has already been handled by Lucien Lachance. Vicente gives you the tools you'll need to fake Motierre's death: a single-use dagger coated with a special poison called Languorwine that can make it appear that a person has died, and an antidote to revive him later.

1. Receive Valtieri's final contract.
2. Travel to Chorrol, and break into Francois Motierre's house.
3. Learn of Motierre's plot to fake his death and wait for Hides-His-Heart to arrive.
4. When Hides-His-Heart arrives, "kill" Motierre and flee.
5. Revive Motierre in the Chapel Undercroft, and lead him to the local inn.
6. Return to Valtieri to collect your reward, advance in rank, and change your Dark Brotherhood liaison.

name: The Battle for Castle Kvatch
canonical:
Try to save the Count of Kvatch

**Canonical Outcome:**
Whenever you're ready, speak to Savlian Matius to begin the battle to free Kvatch Castle. Follow him and any of the survivors from your efforts to the break the city's siege out of the chapel. Savlian is marked as essential, so he cannot be killed, but the rest of your allies are mortal and unleveled. Keeping them alive—although optional—is a challenge at high levels (see the Notes section for tips).

1. Help Savlian Matius fight through the Daedra to reach the castle gates.
2. You are sent to Berich Inian in the Chapel of Akatosh to collect the key to the guard house.
3. Acquire the key, rally your new reinforcements, and make your way through the tunnels to get to the gatehouse and open the gates.
4. Reach and storm the castle, clearing out the Daedra infestation.
5. Find the count's corpse, and recover his signet ring.
6. Return to Savlian Matius with news of the count's death and his ring to finish the quest, and receive your reward.

name: The Bloodworm Helm
canonical:
Find the Bloodworm Helm

**Canonical Outcome:**
Talk to Arch-Mage Traven once you have been promoted to Wizard. He will tell you that the council is divided on the issue of how to deal with Mannimarco, and as a result, the last two artifacts that were known to belong to the Worm King, the Necromancer's Amulet and the Bloodworm Helm, were taken away from the Imperial City by Caranya and Irlav Jarol, respectively. However, having continued misgivings about the safety of the items and their current caretakers, he wants you to retrieve the items back to the University for safekeeping.

1. Talk to Arch-Mage Traven about the missing artifacts.
2. Travel to Fort Teleman and fight through the necromancers to Irlav Jarol.
3. Recover the Bloodworm Helm and return it to Traven.

name: The Coldest Sleep
canonical:
Locate a Havilstein Hoar-Blood

**Canonical Outcome:**
Your next dead drop location is a hollowed-out tree stump in the Market District of the Imperial City, behind Stonewall Shields. Your orders instruct you to travel to Gnoll Mountain to kill Havilstein Hoar-Blood. According to the dead drop orders, he murdered a mead hall chieftain back on Solstheim and the victim's sister wants bloody revenge. This is out of the ordinary, as Nord tradition dictates some form of material compensation.

1. Receive the next contract from the hollowed-out tree stump behind Stonewall Shields.
2. Make your way up the mountain to Hoar-Blood.
3. Decide how you will kill him and his wolf companion.
4. Make your way to the next dead drop.

name: The Collector
canonical:
Help Umbacano

**Canonical Outcome:**
To begin this quest, find an Ayleid Statue. There are ten in total, one in each of the Ayleid ruins listed in the section below. Selling this statue to a merchant will net you a maximum of 250 septims. The statue disappears from the merchant's inventory as soon as you exit the barter screen. After selling the statue, expect to be approached by a messenger after a short period of time. The messenger will take you to Umbacano's Manor in the Talos Plaza District, where you find out that he has purchased the statue from the merchant. Alternatively, take the first statue directly to Umbacano. Enter his manor and show the statue to his butler, Jollring, who will then introduce you to Umbacano. Umbacano will then buy the statue for 500 gold, which is double its base value.

1. Find an Ayleid Statue and sell it.
2. Find and talk to Umbacano.
3. Recover the nine remaining statues.
4. Return them to Umbacano.

name: The Crimson Cave
canonical:
Attend a secret meeting of the Mythic Dawn

**Canonical Outcome:**
After completing the Burning Trail, Ranaline will tell you to go to Mingo Cave while dressed as a member of the Mythic Dawn. She will mark the cave on your map; it is located south of Hircine's Shrine. If you wish to infiltrate the meeting, be sure to put on the Mythic Dawn Hood and Robe given to you by Ranaline before entering the cave. If you unequip either of them while inside, the cultists will turn hostile. Of course, there is nothing preventing you from immediately going on the offensive if you prefer to attack the cultists immediately.

1. Go to Mingo Cave south of Hircine's Shrine.
2. (Optional) Equip a set of Mythic Dawn robes and hood before entering the cave to infiltrate the cult.
3. Head directly north through the cave until you enter the room with three cages.
4. Talk with Mehrunes' Harbinger.
5. Activate the Pyre Wood to burn the caged prisoner or kill all the cultists.
6. Speak with Mehrunes' Harbinger and learn the Summon Mehrunes' Harbinger spell. Use the spell and speak with the Harbinger again to finish the quest.

name: The Desolate Mine
canonical:
Deliver a weapons shipment to the Desolate Mine

**Canonical Outcome:**
This first Cheydinhal Fighters Guild quest - together with the first Anvil Fighters Guild quests, A Rat Problem and The Unfortunate Shopkeeper - is required for advancement in the guild and proceeding to Unfinished Business, but it is completely independent of the other two in terms of order of completion. You can receive this quest before, during, or after any of the Anvil quests.

1. Speak with Burz gro-Khash. He needs you to bring a weapon cache to some guild members at the Desolate Mine.
2. Make your way to the mine and take care of any enemies guarding the entrance.
3. Once inside, speak with Rienna.
4. After discovering how each member prefers to kill goblins, distribute the weapons appropriately.
5. Head into the bowels of the mine with the other three guild members and eliminate all standing resistance.
6. Once the mine is clear, return to Burz gro-Khash for your reward.

name: The Elven Maiden
canonical:
Steal a Llathasa's Bust

**Canonical Outcome:**
Your next job consists of stealing a statuette made in memory of the recently deceased Lady Llathasa Indarys of Cheydinhal. It is only possible to start this quest after you have fenced 100 gold.

1. Receive the next mission from Armand Christophe.
2. Travel to the chapel in Cheydinhal, and gain access to the undercroft.
3. Avoiding all guards, enter Lady Llathasa Indarys' crypt to steal the statuette.
4. Steal the statuette, and return to the Imperial City, only to find yourself in a new predicament.
5. Neutralize any suspicion of Armand Christophe by exposing a snitch in the guild.
6. Plant the statuette in Myvryna Arano's cupboard then alert Hieronymus Lex.
7. Persuade him to search Myvryna's home, and she will be arrested.
8. Once that is done, Armand Christophe will promote you to the rank of "Bandit", and inform you of another doyen to take missions from.

name: The Forlorn Watchman (quest)
canonical:
Lay to rest the The Forlorn Watchman (ghost)

**Canonical Outcome:**
A rumor in Bravil tells of a ghost that walks the shores of Niben Bay each night. Speak to the proprietor of the Silverhome on the Water inn, Gilgondorin, to find out more.

1. Ask about rumors in town and hear about the ghost.
2. Talk to Gilgondorin about the ghost.
3. Speak with the ghost to learn about the Mouth of the Panther.
4. Ask Gilgondorin about the Mouth of the Panther.
5. Visit the Mouth of the Panther, and discover the wrecked Emma May.
6. Make your way through the wreck, taking out the ethereal undead on the way, until you reach the cabin's log book.
7. After reading the log, reach the lower level, and defeat the leader.
8. Take the leader's key to unlock the last room.
9. Free Blakely's corpse, and his ghost appears. He tells you to take the map to lead you to underwater treasure.

name: The Fugitives
canonical:
Find and kill some fugitives that have been causing trouble near Bravil

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak with Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal to learn about a prison escape in Bravil where four fugitives are terrorizing the locals. You are sent to Bravil to round up the fugitives and show them the error of their ways. Travel to Bravil and speak to the locals about the fugitives. You will probably find that most of them are reluctant to speak to you due to their instilled fear. Most likely, you will have to be a bit persuasive. After persuading the locals to loosen their tongues, you will learn that the four fugitives are hiding out in Bloodmayne Cave, located northwest of Bravil near the Larsius River. The location of the fugitives' hideout will be conveniently marked on your map.

1. Speak with Burz gro-Khash to receive this contract.
2. Travel to Bravil and ask anyone about Fugitives to learn about their hideout—Bloodmayne Cave.
3. Travel northwest to the cave and begin the hunt.
4. Return to Burz gro-Khash for your reward and further instructions.

name: The Ghost Ship of Anvil
canonical:
Varulae

**Canonical Outcome:**
On the west side of Anvil Docks, there's a ship called The Serpent's Wake. Speak with Varulae, who is standing on the main deck. She will tell you that the ship has recently returned from Summerset Isle with a family heirloom of hers, a crystal ball. Unfortunately, the crew of the ship has been murdered and their ghosts now haunt the lower decks. Varulae will ask you to go down to the cargo hold and recover her crystal ball. When you agree to help, you're given a key so that you may enter. You can either run this quest quickly, without a fight, or stand against five Spectral Sailors; as with all ghosts, they are immune to normal weapons. Inside the first door is a ghost that will sometimes stay in the room, so you can use a ranged spell to kill it easily, even at a low level. Once a ghost dies it leaves a sharpened cutlass, which can be used to fight other ghosts.

1. Speak with Varulae on the deck of The Serpent's Wake in Anvil Docks.
2. She asks you to retrieve her crystal ball from the cargo hold of the haunted ship.
3. Defeat the Spectral Sailors or run past them, making your way down to the hold.
4. Return Varulae's crystal ball to her, and she rewards you with the enchanted cutlass, Redwave.

name: The Gravefinder's Repose
canonical:
Help the Malene

**Canonical Outcome:**
Talk to Malene behind the counter at the Roxey Inn, and she will tell you that Raelynn the Gravefinder, a necromancer hiding out in Moss Rock Cavern, has been scaring potential customers away from the area. Malene will ask you to kill Raelynn.

1. Speak with Malene behind the counter about the necromancer.
2. Clear Moss Rock Cavern, and corner Raelynn at the end of the cavern.
3. Return to Malene for your leveled gold reward and her thanks.

name: The Hist
canonical:
Return to Blackwood Company

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once again, speak with Modryn Oreyn at his house in Chorrol. The Blackwood Company must be eradicated and Modryn tasks you with heading back to the Blackwood Company Hall in Leyawiin, finding Ri'Zakar and destroying the source of the Company's strength. You must be careful, however, as the Company now know your position and are unlikely to provide with a friendly greeting.

1. Speak with Modryn Oreyn at his home in Chorrol once again.
2. Travel to the Blackwood Company Hall in Leyawiin, kill Ja'Fazir and loot the key to Jeetum-Ze's room from his body.
3. Enter Jeetum-Ze's room and kill him. Loot the key to Ri'Zakar's room from his body.
4. Enter Ri'Zakar's room and kill him. Loot the key to the Blackwood Company Basement from his body.
5. Enter the basement, kill two more Blackwood members and destroy the Hist tree.
6. After having slain an enraged Maglir, return to Modryn Oreyn's house in Chorrol for your reward.
7. Speak to Vilena Donton to be named Master of the Fighters Guild.
8. Return to Modryn Oreyn's house and speak with him to complete the Fighters Guild questline.

name: The Horror of Dive Rock
canonical:
Slay the Horror of Dive Rock

**Canonical Outcome:**
At Dive Rock, near the campfire, you can find Agnar's Journal. This diary tells how Agnar the Unwavering became the chieftain of Thirsk Mead Hall on Solstheim and married Svenja Snow-Song, at some point after an earlier chieftain had rid Thirsk of the fearsome Udyrfrykte. (The earlier chieftain is actually the player of Morrowind, having done The Mead Hall Massacre quest in Bloodmoon.) However, Svenja was still haunted by the memory of the Uderfrykte and the possibility of future attacks, so to rid herself of her nightmares and fears, Svenja felt driven to slay the mother of all the Uderfryktes, the Uderfrykte Matron. Hearing of a horrible creature near Dive Rock, Agnar and Svenja traveled there. In the final diary entry, Agnar the Unwavering had just wavered and fled after his and Svenja's attack on the Uderfrykte Matron had failed miserably. Agnar was about to head back and avenge his wife's death.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal
2. Find and read Agnar's Journal.
3. Locate and destroy the Uderfrykte Matron, loot the corpse to find Frostwyrm Bow, and learn of Agnar's fate.

name: The Killing Field
canonical:
Valus_Odiil

**Canonical Outcome:**
Meet Valus Odiil in The Grey Mare in Chorrol and agree to help him and his sons defend his farm.

1. Speak with Valus Odiil about his sons.
2. Find and talk to his sons.
3. Defend the sons from the goblins.
4. After the three waves of goblins, return to Valus.
5. Receive your reward.

name: The Lonely Wanderer
canonical:
A Faelian

**Canonical Outcome:**
The mini-quest "My Brother's Keeper" instructs you to speak with Ocheeva to receive your next contract. She wants you to find and kill a High Elf named Faelian, somewhere in the Imperial City. She suggests speaking to your fellow Brothers and Sisters for advice. She also warns you not to arouse suspicions with Adamus Phillida, an Imperial Guard Captain and sworn enemy of the Brotherhood and says you must do this killing in a secure indoor location with no witnesses to receive your bonus.

1. Talk to Ocheeva and receive the contract.
2. Travel to the Imperial City.
3. Find out where Faelian lives, then ask around there to figure out his story.
4. Kill Faelian, and return to Ocheeva for the rewards.

name: The Master's Son
canonical:
The Fighters Guild

**Canonical Outcome:**
When you reach the rank of Protector, you will be directed to Modryn Oreyn in Chorrol for further duties. Your job is to take Viranus Donton—the son of the Guildmaster—on a contract to boost his confidence, without his mother knowing about it. The contract itself is to locate Galtus Previa, who has gone missing in Nonwyll Cavern, northwest of Chorrol.

1. Receive the quest details from Modryn Oreyn.
2. Escort Viranus Donton to Nonwyll Cavern.
3. Assist in clearing out the cavern.
4. Return to Modryn Oreyn for your reward.

name: The Necromancer's Amulet
canonical:
Find the Necromancer's Amulet

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once you have been promoted to the rank of Wizard after completing A Plot Revealed, the Arch-Mage will inform you that the Council is in ruins after the events of the previous quest (after having just fallen into disarray upon being informed of the return of Mannimarco). As a part of this more recent upheaval, two artifacts, the Necromancer's Amulet and the Bloodworm Helm, were removed from the University by Caranya and Irlav Jarol, respectively. Having continued misgivings for the safety of the items and their current caretakers, the Arch-Mage wants you to retrieve the items back to the University for safekeeping.

1. Speak to Hannibal Traven a few days after completing A Plot Revealed. He wants you to retrieve the Necromancer's Amulet from Fort Ontus.
2. Find Caranya in Fort Ontus and kill her when she refuses to hand over the amulet.
3. Fight your way out with the amulet and return to Arch-Mage Traven.

name: The Noble's Daughter
canonical:
Find Lord Rugdumph gro-Shurgak

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak to Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal and he will tell you about an old family friend - the Orc nobleman Lord Rugdumph gro-Shurgak. Lord Rugdumph's daughter Lady Rogbut gra-Shurgak has gone missing and he needs the Fighters Guild's help to find her. You're sent to Lord Rugdumph's Estate, located northeast of Lake Arrius, to speak with Lord Rugdumph for more details. Burz will mark its location on your map.

1. Speak with Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal to receive this contract.
2. Travel to Lord Rugdumph's Estate and speak with Lord Rugdumph gro-Shurgak about his daughter's plight.
3. Search the nearby area for Lady Rogbut's whereabouts.
4. Rescue Lady Rogbut and return her to her father.
5. Report back to Burz gro-Khash for your reward and further instructions.

name: The Path of Dawn
canonical:
You must return to Baurus

**Canonical Outcome:**
During this quest, Baurus becomes non-essential, so before going on this quest, it is recommended to obtain some Convalescence spells to assist in keeping him alive.

1. Speak to Jauffre about the Amulet of Kings.
2. Find Baurus in the Imperial City. Help him defeat a Mythic Dawn assassin, which will give you a mysterious book.
3. Track down the rest of the Mythic Dawn Commentaries.
4. # Book Two can be found at the Arcane University.
5. # Book Three can be found at First Edition.
6. # Book Four requires meeting a cultist in the Imperial Sewers, with Baurus.
7. The books give you a location where, in turn, you'll learn where the Mythic Dawn sanctuary is.

name: The Potato Snatcher
canonical:
S'jirra

**Canonical Outcome:**
Enter Faregyl Inn, south of the Imperial City just off the Green Road to Bravil, and speak with the Khajiit S'jirra. She left her Jumbo Potatoes outside, but when she returned to get them so that she could bake her Famous Potato Bread, she saw a huge person running off west with her potatoes.

1. Speak with S'jirra at the Faregyl Inn about her missing potatoes. She will tell you of a huge person who stole them.
2. Find the ogre west of Faregyl Inn, and kill it. Retrieve the potatoes from its corpse.
3. Return them to Faregyl Inn, and speak with S'jirra to claim your reward of S'jirra's Famous Potato Bread.

name: The Purification
canonical:
Things at the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary

**Canonical Outcome:**
The "Of Secret And Shadow" mini-quest directs you to talk to Ocheeva. She tells you that you have received a letter from Lucien. Apparently the Black Hand itself has a task for you. For more details, you need to travel to Lucien's current residence in Fort Farragut, just northeast of Cheydinhal. The letter also warns you that you must not speak to anyone in the Sanctuary about the letter and you should be careful about the residents of the fort.

1. Read Lucien's letter to you.
2. Meet him in Fort Farragut.
3. Eliminate everyone in the Sanctuary.
4. Return to Lucien for your reward and your new way to receive contracts.

name: The Renegade Shadowscale
canonical:
Eradicate a fugitive Shadowscale named Scar-Tail

**Canonical Outcome:**
Any time after you have finished Scheduled for Execution, talking to Teinaava reveals that he has a personal matter that he would like to discuss. Teinaava will only offer to discuss the topic if his disposition towards you is greater than 70. If you say that you are interested, he will reveal that his fellow Shadowscale, Scar-Tail, fled the Black Marsh, violating code, and refuses to return. Because Shadowscale cannot kill their own kin, as in the Dark Brotherhood, he has contacted you to do the dirty work. You are to bring back the Argonian's heart as proof.

1. Speak to Teinaava about Scar-Tail.
2. Head to Bogwater camp, and meet Scar-Tail.
3. Decide what you will do with him.
4. Bring Teinaava the heart of an Argonian to collect your reward.

name: The Rosethorn Cache
canonical:
Find the hidden treasure of a thief who lived 200 years ago.

**Canonical Outcome:**
In the bedroom of Rosethorn Hall, in the loft above the stairs, you will find a scroll called Long Forgotten Note. The scroll provides the clue leading to this quest's treasure. The note is located right against the wall, so you will not be able to see it unless you can jump high enough. Obtaining the note is required for the quest: the treasure is only enabled after you have read the note.

1. Find the hidden scroll containing a riddle.
2. Solve the riddle, find the hourglass, and you receive your reward.

name: The Siren's Deception
canonical:
An all-female gang of thieves is preying on married men in the Anvil

**Canonical Outcome:**
You may hear from some residents in Anvil about an all-female gang of thieves who pick only on married men. They lure them in with their charms and then rob them. You will be pointed in the direction of Gogan, who lives in Gogan's House at the west end of Anvil.

1. Learn from Anvil residents about gang problems.
2. Speak to Maelona and Gogan.
3. Head to The Flowing Bowl and wait for a woman to approach with a tempting offer.
4. Go to Gweden Farm at the pre-arranged time.
5. Confront the gang about their activities, and kill them all.
6. Receive your reward from either Maelona or Gogan.

name: The Stone of St. Alessia
canonical:
The Stone of St. Alessia

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak to Azzan in Anvil. He will tell you that Modryn Oreyn has been kicked out of the Guild as a result of Viranus Donton's death at Forsaken Mine. If you have not yet completed Burz's last two quests, Azzan will also inform you that you have been demoted to Defender for your part in the affair. If asked, he will tell you that you may be able to regain your former rank if you complete "a few contracts" first.

1. Speak with Azzan in Anvil to receive this contract.
2. Travel to the Chapel of Talos in Bruma and speak with Cirroc about the theft of the Stone of St. Alessia by bandits.
3. Follow the bandits out of town - heading east - and you will encounter K'Sharr, one of their members.
4. K'Sharr will tell you that ogres stole the Stone from the bandits. The ogres are holed up in Sedor - an Ayleid ruin (quite a ways) to the east.
5. Proceed to Sedor and retrieve the Stone, evading or eliminating any ogres you encounter.
6. Return the Stone to Cirroc and he will reward you with three Strong Potions of Healing.
7. Report back to Azzan for payment and he will inform you that he has no more contracts for you.

name: The Sunken One (quest)
canonical:
Find the Slythe Seringi

**Canonical Outcome:**
Go to Shetcombe Farm, which is close to Kvatch's eastern side (just below the 'h' in Kvatch on the map), north of the road from Skingrad to Kvatch. Enter the farmhouse to find that it is empty.

1. Search Shetcombe's abandoned farmhouse for a diary page.
2. Explore the nearby Sandstone Cavern to find more entries of the diary.
3. Find Slythe at the end of the cavern.
4. Get the last diary entry.
5. Either flee from the cavern or defeat the Sunken One. Collect the offering if you so choose.

name: The Ultimate Heist
canonical:
Steal an Elder Scrolls

**Canonical Outcome:**
Once more, Amusei summons you to see the Gray Fox. This time Amusei will send you to Othrelos' house in the Imperial City. The last three quests were a preparation for the ultimate job: retrieve an Elder Scroll from the Imperial Palace. He makes no secret that this will be a most dangerous and daring task and warns you to be prepared. He gives a detailed plan for the heist, involving going through the sewers into the Old Way (an old escape route) to reach the Elder Library, impersonating Celia Camoran to intercept the scroll, and making the getaway. He gives you an Imperial Sewer Key for access to the Palace Sewers, the restored Arrow of Extrication, and the Boots of Springheel Jak. He also tells you that there will be no blood price during this quest.

1. After fencing at least 1000 gold in stolen items, the Gray Fox will contact you for a mission.
2. Sneak into the Imperial Palace Basement and activate the Glass of Time to enter the Imperial City's sewers.
3. Make your way through The Old Way and The Lost Catacombs to the Hall of Epochs.
4. Sneak through the Imperial Palace to the Elder Library.
5. After receiving the Elder Scroll, escape from the Imperial Battlemage's Room and return to the Gray Fox.
6. Take the ring the Gray Fox gave you to the Countess of Anvil, Millona Umbranox.
7. After some secrets are revealed, accept the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal to become the new Thieves Guild Guildmaster and Gray Fox.

name: The Unbeaten Path
canonical:
Follow the clues given to you by a mysterious Notes#Note000B073C

**Canonical Outcome:**
Look outside on the eastern side of Fort Coldcorn, on the big wall around the back of the fort. The fort's walls can be easily climbed onto from the northwest of the fort. East of there you will find a chest containing random loot (including 10% chance of enchanted jewelry and 5% chance of an enchanted weapon), a Key of Hidden Wealth, and a strange note. Next to the chest is a fine steel longsword. The note reads: :The sword leads the way. :Half a mile. :It's just past the big rock on the right.

1. Note: This quest does not appear in your journal
2. Find and read the strange note on the eastern side of Fort Coldcorn outside the fort.
3. Find the hidden treasure by following the clue you have been given.

name: The Unfortunate Shopkeeper
canonical:
Stop some thieves from robbing a Norbert Lelles

**Canonical Outcome:**
Azzan asks you to speak to Norbert Lelles at Lelles' Quality Merchandise. The store is outside Anvil, in the harbor district along the dock. Ask Norbert about Break-Ins to learn that he's lost a great deal of merchandise over the past month. The thieves always come at night after he has gone to sleep. Norbert gives you permission to stay overnight to guard the store. He mentions that he'll be staying next door at the Flowing Bowl Inn until you resolve the matter.

1. Speak with Azzan.
2. Talk to Norbert Lelles at Lelles' Quality Merchandise.
3. Confront the burglars.
4. Defeat the burglars.
5. Return to Lelles to receive your reward.

name: The Wandering Scholar
canonical:
Elante of Alinor

**Canonical Outcome:**
Speak with Azzan in Anvil, who tells you that Elante of Alinor wishes to study a Daedric shrine and has contacted the Fighters Guild for protection. Travel to Brittlerock Cave, northwest of Kvatch and due east of Fort Sutch. Elante will be waiting inside.

1. Receive this quest from Azzan in Anvil.
